Assisting activities have to be generated and the growth of the organization has to be highlighted.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Monitoring of LPG Gas Cylinders to Prevent Hazards
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: It is important to prioritize safety in all aspects of our lives, especially when it comes to handling potentially dangerous substances like LPG gas cylinders. The solution proposed is a great way to address the risks associated with gas cylinders, and it incorporates several innovative features that can help prevent accidents and ensure safe usage. The inclusion of gas leakage and fire detection systems is essential for detecting and responding to potential hazards in a timely manner. Additionally, the weight monitoring system and automatic gas booking feature can help prevent scams and ensure that users have a constant supply of gas. The voice-controlled feature is also a great addition to the system, making it easier for users to operate the regulator and trolley without having to physically interact with them. This can reduce the risk of accidents caused by the mishandling of the equipment. This smart and intelligent system has the potential to significantly decrease life risks that may be due to the usage of LPG cylinders. It is important to prioritize safety when handling any potentially hazardous material, and solutions like this can go a long way in ensuring that accidents are minimized and risks are mitigated.

articleTitle: IoT-based medical system with fog assistance for patients with cardiovascular illnesses
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The current necessity of the hour is IoT-based patient monitoring. Patients with major medical illnesses and cardiac diseases have relied heavily on the critical care services. One of the main causes of the wait times for specific healthcare monitoring services offered by hospitals is the growing population. The contemporary internet era & IoT-centred healthcare arrangements offer medicinal facilities for people & hospital to predict or premature-detect likely critical care scenarios. A new healthcare support structure for cardiac patients to track & communicate with clinics is the suggested course of action. To assist the decision aid system, we developed a Cloud supported Internet of Things oriented cardiac monitoring system. This application was evaluated against existing analogue healthcare systems to demonstrate its outstanding quality.

articleTitle: Exploring The Uncertain Effects of AI-Powered Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The effect of AI-powered robotics on the labor market is examined in this study report. It addresses how AI is displacing human labor in certain functions like employment and demand scheduling. AI-assisted prediction and choice-making may result in higher efficiency and output. The article also emphasizes that outsourcing prediction duties might occasionally contribute to increased labor levels. The establishment of new duties for decision-making is made possible when computerized forecasting lowers uncertainty. Although there aren't many concrete instances of new occupations produced by AI developments, there may be room for creative opportunities for employment.The labor market is being significantly impacted by the fast-evolving field of artificial intelligence (AI). Human jobs are increasingly being replaced by automation driven by AI, which trend is predicted to continue. Although it is unclear how AI will affect employment, it is expected to result in job cuts in certain sectors and job increases in others. Humans ought to be ready for adaptation to these adjustments since AI will additionally going to modify the skills needed for jobs.

articleTitle: Prediction of Infant Growth using the Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Every parent is curious about their child's internal and exterior development. Childhood is the first stage of a person's existence. To comprehend and better explain many elements of action, including the emotional, physical, social, intellectual, perceptual, and personality development, extensive research has been done in the past. Child development analysis is a scientific approach to evaluate growth, change, and stability. By learning more about how and why individuals develop and grow, one may better understand and meet a child's needs, allowing them to realize their full potential. Child development has a broad scope and a general purpose. However, just a few studies on early childhood development have been conducted. The project's objective is to use machine learning algorithm to forecast a child's future learning behavior and talents using a random forest algorithm and data-mining approach.

articleTitle: Role of AI Algorithm Approaches for the Use of Weather Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Weather forecasting used to be done with the use of big, sophisticated physics models that used fantastic atmospheric conditions over a lengthy period of time. These settings are frequently unstable as a result of changes to the climate device, which causes the models to provide inaccurate projections. The models are frequently run on a large number of nodes in a high-performance computing (HPC) environment, which uses a lot of power. In this research, we describe a novel approach for recognizing meteorological data utilizing contemporary technologies such as Artificial Neural Networks, Python Machine Learning, and Data Mining.As we appreciate the importance of weather forecasting in the day-to-day lives of people all around the world. We demonstrate how several strategies are used to obtain a certain climate scenario for the near future in a short length of time, or even just one click, which benefits humans in a variety of ways. These tactics may be implemented in considerably less resource-intensive settings. The results of the evaluation show that the precision of present-day clothes is sufficient for usage with modern procedures. These methods use one-of-a-kind criteria to forecast daily weather in terms of current rainfall, humidity, temperature, cloud cover, and the current day the day.This report provides information on how modern technology has improved climate predictions.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Technology Mobile Edge Computing System Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The notion of Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) is now being used as a response to the multiplicity of requests for high-quality computing services. It comprises a lot of crucial processes including task completion, data transport, and allocating resources. Also, scientists enhanced the MEC state's dependability using blockchain based. Allocating resources with in Mesh network is now a popular subject, but there remain a few problems with the procedure in the classic MEC architecture, such as security exposure and other difficulties. In addition, a blockchain-based MEC network, the resource allocation problem would be more sophisticated, and the mining process may have an influence on resource distribution policy. This study analyses the resource allocation problem using a blockchain-based MEC system architecture to handle this issue. To improve resource allocation strategy, the asynchronous advantage Actor-Critic (A3C) method is utilised. The findings reveal that the TCN-based A3C algorithm not only converges quicker but is also more stable.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Effectiveness of Machine Learning Models in Nifty50 Next Day Prediction: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The stock market is a prediction is a complicated task and is difficult to predict accurately using traditional methods. It also relates to the economy of the country. Advance knowledge and education can make a person a good investor. Machine learning algorithms have shown great efficiency in predicting the short term and long-term stock prices by analyzing a large amount of historical data. In this research, we compare the performance of five popular machine learning algorithms in predicting stock prices: Random Forest, SVR, Ridge, Lasso Regression and KNN model. The study is conducted using a dataset of historical stock prices of the NIFTY50 index, covering the period from March 2022 to March 2023. The performance of the models is evaluated using various metrics, including Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and R squared (R2). The results show that the (SVR) Support Vector Regression model outperforms the other models in terms of accuracy followed by Lasso and Random Forest with same accuracy and then followed by KNN and at last Ridge model.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Segmentation using K means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Customer Segmentation plays a vital role in CRM, where we are managing all your organization’s relationships and interactions between the customers. It helps to find potential customers and to take proper decisions in digital marketing. Segmenting or grouping the customers based on various attributes like age, gender, interest, and purchase behavior helps e-commerce companies to increase their revenue. One of the major problems today in customer segmentation is the level of noise in the data, which increases the data storage as well as impacts the data mining analysis results. This research focuses on filtering the noise in the data and a comparison study of various clustering algorithms will be done, and results will be analyzed, and a new generic data model will be built that works with any e-commerce platform data. More than doing the customer segmentation in this study we will also analyze how customers responded to the marketing campaigns.

articleTitle: Sparsely Supervised Learning for Medical Image Classification on Noisy Heterogeneous Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In a number of tasks for assessing natural and medical prints, deep neural networks have bettered humans. These achievements, however, are solely reliant on properly labelled training data. When presented with a few samples of noisy-labelled images, the network training strategy might encounter difficulties, resulting in a suboptimal classification models. The quality of medical picture annotations strongly depends on the knowledge and experience of the annotators, which makes this difficulty more acute in the context of medical image analysis. Such problem arises due to a number of reasons ranging from human error, inexperience or even misreading of the images. But at the same time, proper labels are exceptionally useful in training models, while improperly labelled data actually hampers the efficiency of the model. Label for a lot of the image dataset out there is actually already generated, but when we think about the noisy labelled data and go for an unsupervised learning model instead of a supervised model the labels that are correct are also going to waste. To solve this problem without wasting labels, a sparsely supervised learning strategy based on transfer learning is constructed with the aid of the keras Xception model. This paper compares the efficiency of a sparsely supervised learning model employing transfer learning to that of other traditional CNN models based on their performance metrics.

articleTitle: The Role of AI and Blockchain in Supply Chain Traceability
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Optimizing the abilities to boost numerous goals, such as budget, service, and reliability, is at the core of industrial automation. To do this, supply chain management must adopt the product lifecycle, manufacturing systems lifecycle, and economic cycle. In a nutshell, a manufacturing company generates a massive quantity of data. A distribution network stakeholder has accessibility to its data and may utilize AI to draw new insights. Since only little information is provided to the consumer, only a limited context can be established. With blockchain, everyone can see everyone else's data. As a result, an individual's stakeholder insights will be more substantial. This will aid in establishing an intelligent supply chain

articleTitle: Detection of Parkinson disease for handwriting dataset using deep learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The most common neurodegenerative diseases are Parkinson's disease. People who have reached the age of 70 or older are affected. Parkinson's disease is the second incurable illness after Almeria's disease. The numerous characteristics that distinguish between people with Parkinson's disease and those who are healthy, and earlier diagnosis of the disease results in reduced disease severity. These are the typical signs of Parkinson's disease, which include both motor and non-motor deficiency in patients. The handwritten data set, which includes spiral and wave drawings, was retrieved from UCI equipment. EfficientnetB3 provides high accuracy in comparison to the current CNN model. To increase efficiency, EfflcientnetB3 shrinks the parameter size and equally scales each dimension using a predetermined set of scaling dimensions. The proposed model Adam –EfficientNet achieves 98.3 % which is the best accuracy compared to all other existing CNN models.

articleTitle: Role of the Internet of Things in Smart Cities: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has gained significant traction by offering technology for linking different gadgets to the Internet and enabling communications between machines and humans. Many tech and business communities have invested a lot in IoT research and development over the past two decades. However, IoT technology is still in its infancy, and many challenges must be solved. IoT is a common buzzword in IT sector. IoT transforms real-world objects and technical gadgets into intelligent virtual beings which can communicate over the internet. By uniting everything in our environment under a unified infrastructure, the IoT intends to make it possible for us to manage and keep an eye on the things in our immediate surroundings. The current study analyses IoT concepts by conducting a methodical review of academic journals, business white papers, interviews with industry professionals, and online databases. Moreover, this research article focuses on the application of IoT in smart cities. This article aims to give an overview of IoT and its important technologies, along with their scope in making smart cities. This article discusses in depth many IoT-based applications. IOT makes use of different technologies, viz. Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) as well as Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN). It emphasizes the fact that devices that everyone uses commonly are connected via the Internet. Amidst this intricate situation, the incorporation of IoT in an urban setting holds particular significance as a means to address the government's focus on utilizing IoT-based devices for public affairs management, in order to realize the smart city paradigm.

articleTitle: Construction of Trust Management using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Recent events have brought to the forefront concerns over the dependability of decentralized social networks (DOSN). Malicious individuals may engage in such activities in order to artificially inflate their trustworthiness in the network and, as a result, increase their chances of being selected by other users, which presents a risk of untrustworthy connections and partnerships in a decentralized social networking system. This risk is caused by the presence of individuals who may engage in such activities. Under these circumstances, customers won't be able to accurately evaluate the credibility of the recommendations for social services they have been provided. As a consequence of this, a trust management model is necessary in order to defend the integrity of the system against attacks and to direct users toward trustworthy social services. To this aim, we propose an innovative strategy for trust management as a means of protecting against attacks motivated by a lack of enough confidence. In light of this, the strategy that we have recommended takes use of a cutting-edge invention known as blockchain in order to accomplish this objective. At this time, Blockchain only considers physical security; thus, we wish to incorporate cognitive security based on the recognized trust-related flaws. The findings of the assessment indicate that our methodology is effective.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Blockchain in Supply Chain Finance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Covid-19 pandemic has highlighted the inadequacies of traditional paper-based supply chain finance and trade systems. Digitalization offers a solution to reduce friction in global trade. This evaluation examines the latest commercial applications and theoretical perspectives on the use of blockchain technology in supply chain finance systems as a medium for digitalization. We argue that blockchain technology has the potential to revolutionize distribution network finance by eliminating inefficiencies and improving communication between parties, which are currently major obstacles to progress in this field. We examine the financial, operational, and legal challenges in supply chain finance and evaluate how blockchain technology can address these challenges through a review of the literature and analysis of industrial approaches. We discuss both the limitations and benefits of blockchain technology and identify the necessary conditions for the implementation of blockchain-enabled supply chains.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection System Using the Movement of the Eye of A Human Through Machine Learning Algorithms in Order to Avoid Accidents
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This function is meant to keep individuals safe in the event of an accident. In this study, the development of ADAS is shown, with a focus on driver fatigue identification as the main goal of decreasing traffic fatalities. In this situation, we use artificial intelligence to anticipate the condition and sentiments of the operator, improving traffic safety. For this research, we'll use CNN, which can accurately detect driver fatigue from driving images. In this study, we can employ the Electrocardiographic to measure weariness psychologically. Artificial intelligence refers to a system's ability to learn and grow without having to be programmed. We also employ OpenCv, Keras, and Tensorflow, among other machine learning algorithms [1].Road accidents are rising quickly each year as a result of vehicle technology and mechanical developments that allow for fast driving. Road accidents claim the lives of 1.35 million people worldwide every year, with 151 thousand fatalities reported in India alone in 2016. From this, drivers are at fault for almost 78 percent of traffic incidents. Drunk driving, over speeding, and sleepiness are the main causes of these incidents, with drowsiness accounting for roughly 40% of all accidents.People are aware of the dangers of driving after drinking, but they are not aware of the dangers of tiredness since there are no tools available to gauge driver fatigue.When a motorist is distracted while driving, it slows down their response time and affects how they steer. In order to address this issue, we'll employ machine learning to determine whether or not the driver is sleepy [2]. By setting a threshold number, we can determine if the driver is tired or not. articleTitle: A Review on Phishing Technique: Classification, Lifecycle and Detection Approaches

articleTitle: Exploring the technological barriers of AI in Management Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This abstract explores the ethical implications of using artificial intelligence (AI) in management decision making. As AI technology continues to advance and become more integrated into various industries, it is important to consider the potential impact on decision making processes and the potential consequences of relying on AI-generated insights. The ethical considerations include issues such as bias in data, transparency in decision making, and accountability for AI-generated decisions. Additionally, the abstract discusses the importance of responsible implementation and regulation of AI in management decision making to ensure fair and just outcomes. Overall, the abstract highlights the need for ongoing examination and consideration of the ethical implications of using AI in management decision making.

articleTitle: Implementation of Natural Language Processing for sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The application of NLP to the field of customer service has the potential to significantly raise levels of satisfaction among users and revenue generated from those users. Among the many applications of natural language processing in customer service discussed in this article are sentiment analysis, text categorization, and language creation. With the use of sentiment analysis, businesses may gauge the tone of a customer's feedback and tailor their response appropriately. Automatically forwarding customer service enquiries to the correct team is a viable use case for text categorization. Through the use of language generation, answers to commonly requested queries may be generated mechanically.Furthermore, the article delves into the economic gains that may result from using NLP in the service sector. Some examples of these advantages include reduced spending on administrative activities as a result of automating them, and an increase in sales as a result of happier customers. The necessity for extensive volumes of training data and the possibility of bias in the algorithms are two of the main obstacles and concerns for adopting NLP in customer service that are discussed in the article.

articleTitle: Big Data Statistics: Methods, Gaps, And Prospects For Supply-Chain Managing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Big Data Analytics (BDA) in supply-chain management (SCM). This is because BDA may be used for a variety of SCM tasks, such as customer behavior assessment, market analysis, and forecasting. To provide a categorization of these implementations, pinpoint the gaps, as well as provide recommendations for further study, we look into the predicting BDA applications in supplier load forecasting in this assessment. Time-series forecasts, sorting, KNN, artificial neural, multiple regressions, svms, and regressors are just some of the techniques we categorise along with their uses in logistics management. articleTitle: Prediction of Thyroid Disease Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The detection and prognosis of diseases is one of the most significant uses of machine learning. Recently, disease classification and identification have benefited greatly and been significantly influenced by machine learning algorithms. One of these problems should cause people to worry about their health because the thyroid gland regulates metabolism, which is vital for maintaining human health. For the purpose of diagnosing thyroid disease, this study employed four machine learning methods: SVM, LR, DT & NB. According to this study, there are three types of thyroid disease: hyper, hypo, and normal. The laboratories of an Iraqi hospital provided the 2690 records that served as the basis for this investigation's data. Machine learning algorithms have shown promise in the diagnosis of thyroid disorders, assisting physicians and healthcare professionals in making an early diagnosis and improving the likelihood of therapy. Using all the features, Decision tree algorithm produced the greatest accuracy of 98.93%, however the Logistic regression approach earned the highest accuracy of 95.73% by removing three qualities (query thyroxine, query hypothyroid, and query hyperthyroid).

This work is dedicated towards image classification using deep learning by comparing various classification models based on their architecture performance and accuracy. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is a type of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) that learns the structural representation of an image and make predictions about its contents. The main layers of the model, known as the Convolutional layers. It detects and analyzes specific patterns in the image using filters. Overall, the use of NLP in customer service can lead to faster resolution times, improved customer satisfaction, and increased efficiency for support teams.

The research gathers text data written by employees from a variety of sources and uses NLP methods to extract pertinent aspects including sentiment analysis and text categorization. Smart contracts are used to store the extracted characteristics on a blockchain network, guaranteeing the results' transparency and immutability. Utilizing the characteristics that have been retrieved and the data that has been recorded on the blockchain network, the workers' performance is assessed in the last phase. This helps to reduce the probability of counterfeit goods being sold and ensures that regulatory requirements are met. The uses of blockchain technology in the health supplement sector are investigated in this article. These applications include traceability, inventory management, and payment processing. In addition to this, it offers a discussion of the difficulties and constraints that may arise from applying blockchain technology to the management of the supply chain for nutritional supplements, as well as potential solutions for overcoming these obstacles. In the health supplement industry as a whole, the implementation of blockchain technology has the potential to promote transparency, accountability, and trust, which would ultimately be to the advantage of both customers and enterprises. The promising findings of this study done thus far highlight the necessity of future research and the use of blockchain technology in the health supplement business.

articleTitle: The technical Role of Regression Analysis in prediction and decision making
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Regression analysis is a statistical method commonly used in finance for understanding and predicting the relationship between the different parameters. This technique can be used in a variety of financial decision-making contexts, such as forecasting stock prices, estimating the cost of capital, and assessing the impact of economic indicators on financial markets. The goal of this study is to explore the role of regression analysis in financial decision making by examining its applications, limitations, and potential for future developments. The study will provide an overview of the various types of regression models used in finance, as well as the advantages and disadvantages of each. Additionally, the study will examine recent developments in the field of regression analysis and their potential implications for financial decision making. Overall, this study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the role of regression analysis in financial decision making and its potential for further advancement

articleTitle: Facial Landmarks Detection System with OpenCV Mediapipe and Python using Optical Flow (Active) Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: To achieve positive detection results, a variety of face landmark methods supported by the convolutional neural network have been developed. The instability landmarks thus emerge in video frames as a result of CNNs, on the other hand, are extremely sensitive to input picture noise. This paper provides a light and effective face landmark identification technology based on a lightweight U-Net model based on semantic segmentation and an Optical Flow (Active) Approach (OFA) for solving the problem of landmark shaking. The OFA employs a quick optical flow approach to determine the motion path of the landmark, as well as a route to increasing landmark maintenance. A lightweight U-Net model is used to predict face landmarks with a reduced size of the model and lower computational. To subsume unstable shaking, the predictable face landmarks are given into the OFA technique as well. Finally, various benchmark datasets are used to produce a comparison of many common methodologies as well as the proposed detection process. A lightweight U-Net model is used to model face landmarks in reduced model size and lower computational. To subsume the unstable shaking, the predicted face landmarks are given into the OFA technique as well. Finally, various benchmark datasets are used to produce a comparison of many common methodologies as well as the proposed detection process.

articleTitle: Loan Approval Prediction using Machine Learning: A Comparative Analysis of Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The prediction of loan approval is a crucial task for financial institutions, and has been a longstanding challenge in the industry. Historically, banks and other lenders relied on manual processes and subjective criteria to evaluate loan applications, which often led to inconsistent decisions and increased risk of loan defaults. With the rise of machine learning techniques, there is now an opportunity to develop more accurate and reliable predictive models that can help financial institutions make better lending decisions.This study proposes a comparative analysis of various machine learning algorithms for predicting loan approval. The explored algorithms include Random Forest Classifier, K-Nearest Neighbors Classifier, Support Vector Classifier, and Logistic Regression. The dataset is prepared by performing exploratory data analysis and feature engineering.Statistics like as accuracy score, F1 score, and ROC score are used to judge the execution of each approach.The findings show that the Random Forest Classifier had the highest accuracy of 98.04%, followed by K-Nearest Neighbors Classifier (78.49%), Logistic Regression (79.60%), and Support Vector Classifier (68.71%). These results highlight the potential of machine learning algorithms to improve the loan approval process and reduce the risk of loan defaults.Overall, this study provides insights into the effectiveness of different machine learning algorithms for loan approval prediction, and can be useful for financial institutions in improving their decision-making process. The proposed approach can also be extended to other domains where classification is a critical task.

articleTitle: Smart Buildings with Self-Supervised Learning: Exploratory Research in Energy Efficiency and Occupant Comfort
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this piece of research, how self-supervised learning could be used to make smart buildings is discussed. By continuously learning and adapting, smart buildings can optimize energy consumption, reduce costs, and improve the overall occupant experience. Self-Supervised learning technique has the potential to greatly enhance both energy efficiency and occupant comfort while simultaneously lowering operational expenses. It is shown how smart buildings can use the power of self-supervised learning algorithms to keep learning and adapting to new situations. This results in a physical environment that is more intelligent and sustainable. Future building design and management may be drastically altered by this technology.

articleTitle: Developing an Blockchain-Based System for E-Commerce Inventory Management
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The era of directly saving data is over. We have decided to store and move our data online. The modern concept of data digitalization has advantages and disadvantages of its own. Nowadays, cyber security remains a major problem. The hazards of a breach and cyberattacks are unavoidable as more data is transferred online. The online conveyance of goods and payments that does not necessitate travel is the basis for all of ecommerce. Cyber-attacks can affect e-commerce transactions and the exchange of transactional data. The main goal of our study is to create a system that guards against certain anomalies, particularly while transferring transactional data, and to also put in place an automatic mechanism that makes sure these transactions go off without a hitch. We are utilizing cutting-edge technological advances like blockchain and smart contracts to put this into practice. Blockchain enables the safe storage and secure network-wide transit of data using a decentralized, unchangeable digital ledger. Blockchain technology enables quicker, safer, and more secure transaction transfers in ecommerce. The homologous transaction method and data encryption made possible by blockchain allow for the secure movement of transactional data. It is exchanged using blockchain. A smart contract is a unique software application that uses digital means to activate, verify, and execute a contract’s conditions. As long as the agreement is in force, it offers transactional security. Blockchain and smart contracts will transfer e-commerce in the coming years. We have coupled smart contracts with blockchain to preserve the transaction standard while also ensuring data security and user privacy. The outcomes of developing and putting into practice the suggested system—which offers a remedy for transactional data privacy—are described.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Traffic Sign Recognition using ResNet Architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Traffic sign recognition is an important task in the field of computer vision and is often used in various applications such as autonomous vehicles, intelligent transportation systems, and road safety systems. Identifying and categorizing the many traffic signs that are present in the environment, such as speed limits, stop signs, and pedestrian crossings, among others, is the goal of traffic sign identification. In this study, we use all iterations of the well-known deep neural network architecture such as Residual Neural Network (ResNet) to conduct an empirical analysis of the recognition of traffic signs. Using the recognition benchmark dataset of German Traffic Signs (GTSRB), which contains 43 different classes of traffic signs, we assess the performance of different ResNet architectures such as ResNet50, ResNet50V2, ResNet101, ResNet101V2, ResNet152 and ResNet152V2. We evaluate all these ResNet architecture performances based on their accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. According to the outcomes of our experiments, ResNet50V2 achieves the maximum accuracy of 99.78%, while ResNet152 achieves the lowest accuracy of 99.49%. We also noted that the accuracy of the ResNet50V2 model grows along with the architecture’s depth. To enhance the performance of these DL architectures, image preprocessing techniques such as resizing, zero-centring and normalization is applied to the traffic sign images. The reshaped matrix of the pre-processed images is then fed into the ResNet models according to their architectures. The results of this study demonstrate that the power of different ResNet architectures with image pre-processing, reshaping the matrix, and training time can significantly improve the performance of traffic sign recognition.

articleTitle: Autonomous Height Adjustable Speed Reducer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Speed reducers have arbitrary character of speed waves, which takes into consideration their height, width, and vision at midnight,that may trigger vehicle overturns, particularly those involving two-wheeled,Consequently, an entirely novel effort is created to address the problem.This new novel invention will greatly aid in the management of water in daily life as well as the avoidance of mishaps. This new invention will have a speed breaker made primarily of plastic (PC plastic). The plastic’s tensile strength and speed breaker’s hardness are both increased with the aid of this poly carbonate substance. This speed breaker will be equipped with LED shutter lights that will be connected to an esp32 micro controller and the colours of the lights will be red and orange in colour. It will make various patterns at night and on foggy days in winter so that everyone can see it clearly from a distance. This innovative work will have a rainwatercollecting system linked to it so that there won’t be a problem with water logging on wet days and the speed breaker will be clearly visible to everyone and can slow down the speed of vehiclesfrom a mile away. The unique feature of this speed breaker isthat it will automatically alter its height based on the weather,so as to prevent accidents. In the event of water logging during rainy days, its height will automatically decrease to safeguard human life. This innovative work will benefit law enforcement as well.Since it has a spike that can be used as an emergency tool, controlled by an esp32, and this will aid in flattening a thief’s Tyre if it is moving. All the power which will be needed willbe given with the help of solar power and the public electricity will be used as a backup system in this technological work. So, this model will help a lot in preventing road accidents and also having a positive effect toward the nature.

articleTitle: A Review On: Deep Learning Model For Skin Lesion Classification Using Imbalance Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks (DCNNs) have undergone extensive research for the identification of skin diseases, and some of them have demonstrated diagnostic accuracy superior to that of dermatologists. However, small size and data imbalance are two issues that prevent large-scale implementation of DCNNs for skin-disease detection. A single-model approach has been proposed for skin lesion classification on small as well as imbalanced datasets. In addition, to verify the fact that moderate complexity DCNNs outperform large models, several DCNNs are trained on imbalance datasets. After this regularization Drop-Out and Drop-Block has been added to reduce overfitting, which is a significant issue in small datasets. The modified Rand Augmentation strategy is proposed to reduce overfitting and address sample underrepresentation. Further, in order to address the problems of variable sample size and classification complexity and to lessen the effect of anomalous samples on training, a distinctive multi-weighted new loss function as well as an end-to-end cumulative learning strategy(CLS) are presented. Our single DCNN approach, when combined with Modified Rand Augment, the MWNL, and the CLS, produced classification accuracy on dermoscopic image datasets that was comparable to or better than theirs. Additionally, given that it operated at a lower cost in terms of processing resources and inference time, this technique might be applied in the mobile devices for automated diagnostics of skin lesions and the malignancies.

articleTitle: Optimization of Load Balancing Algorithm in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A rapidly expanding service, cloud computing (CC) uses a pay-per-use business model. As far as capacity, organization, web administrations, and so forth, innovation offers various administrations. Regardless, the expansion of these organizations and the enormous flood in user demand has made it trying to stay aware of execution as per QoS assessment and SLA chronicles that cloud suppliers make available to businesses. This growth brought about difficulties like load balancing. In addition, it became challenging to meet customer expectations for response speed and work scheduling deadlines. This research suggests an optimal approach based on schedule limitations using the Machine Learning Classification technique to overcome these issues. The main goals of the suggested technique are to increase productivity, optimise server resources by taking into account the importance of various users' tasks, and prevent server failure. Based on the most recent literature, our suggested method will address the aforementioned problems and the existing research gap.

articleTitle: Using Natural Language Processing for Biometric Identification Optimizatoin
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The use of natural language processing (NLP) methods for assessing employee performance is examined in this research article. The paper suggests a technique for extracting pertinent information on work performance from employee-generated text data, such as emails, chats, and feedback surveys. The suggested approach makes use of NLP methods including topic modelling, sentiment analysis, and text classification to extract characteristics that may be utilized as performance indicators for employees. The study's findings imply that the suggested approach, when compared to more conventional assessment techniques, may provide a more comprehensive perspective of employee performance, and assist managers in reaching more informed conclusions about that performance.

articleTitle: The barriers of Implementation block chain technology in the field of Banking Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The purpose of a distributed ledger like a blockchain is to improve processes and create new business models for financial institutions by connecting blocks holding transaction details chronologically to construct chains. This study’s goal is to examine real-world situations. So that a picture of financial institution business model innovation may be created. Case study methodology was used because there aren't enough actual measurement data. ICT officers from significant banks were surveyed by the authors. The interview's goal was to gain insight into how blockchain works in connection to financial institutions' business models, as well as the implications and difficulties that this relationship presents.From the standpoint of banking institutions, the advent of Blockchain is not simply significant from a technological standpoint (it is the birth of a highly efficient database system), but it also has the potential to revolutionize consumer financial transaction patterns if the business models of current financial intermediaries are eliminated or diminished. For the purpose of this paper's research, it was found that the distributed feature of Cryptocurrency cannot be used while creating financial services.

articleTitle: HYBRIDROID: Using Hierarchical Machine Learning Algorithms to Spot Malicious Applications on Linux-Powered Smart phones: Deep Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Since the previous two decades, mobile phones have played a significant role in our lives. Android is the most widely used operating system for mobile devices. The rapidly evolving environment surrounding Android has attracted hackers who want to produce malware. Applications from the Android Market and other websites can be downloaded and installed on Android devices. This gives hackers the chance to repackage harmful code and insert it into legal programmers. Numerous malware detection methods have been proposed, and several frameworks for their identification that make use of both static and dynamic investigative methods have been developed. Different machine learning techniques are used to classify apps based on behavior in a new fusion approach. This offers excellent efficiency and accuracy in malware detection by combining static and dynamic analysis. The results of the experiments demonstrated high precision and excellent memory and power efficiency.

articleTitle: Big Data: An Intensive Review of its Technical Uses in Various Applications and its Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Thousands of interconnected sensors that are embedded into things like cellular telephones, cashier computers, cars, or weather forecasting are being used by organizations in an expanding number of ways to learn more about their clients, competitors, and activities. This expansion begs the issue of just how businesses handle these Big Data—or constantly growing volumes of data—in a manageable way. As a result, this publication's objective is to pinpoint the many Big Data techniques that a corporation may use as well as a collection of organizational contingencies elements that affect method selection. To do this, we analyzed the body of knowledge in the disciplines of Big Data analytics, systems engineering, and actionable insights. We then consolidated our results into a probability matrix that might aid operators in selecting an appropriate Big Data strategy. The hybrid algorithm, which combines conventional rdbms architecture with Dremel processes, is the option we found to be most often useful for businesses undertaking Big Data analytics, even if each methodology might be advantageous under specific company situations.

articleTitle: An AI-Centred Adaptive Cognitive Network Traffic Modelling & Measurement Technique For EIS
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The IoT is the foundation of the Enterprise Information System (EIS), which collects a lot of business information. For EIS, timely, accurate data analysis & transfer are crucial. For net management & traffic optimization in EIS, Network infrastructure traffic is crucial. Nevertheless, the needs for fine-grain traffic monitoring are in conflict with the monitoring overheads & precision. Long-standing promises of artificial intelligence (AI) include the ability to recognise the physical attributes of network activity & take appropriate steps in response. In order to decrease network monitoring overheads & increase measurement precision, we present an AI centred between light Adapt Measuring System (ALAMM) for SDN in this study. Initially, we simulate & forecast the network congestion information using AI. We suggest an adaptive strategy to choose the rate of traffic sample centred on the outcomes of traffic forecasting. Next, we instruct switching devices to evaluate the coarse-grain traffic of flow pattern & networks using the measuring primitives. In order to retrieve the Fine grained (FG) assessment & optimise the measured values, the matrices refilling & optimizing approach is finally suggested. Simulated outcomes demonstrate that our method can accurately and efficiently determine network activity.

articleTitle: Corporate Social Responsibility Reports: A Big Data Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The environmental consumption in the businesses related to discharge of waste into water land and air as well as the working conditions of the employees at the workplace are considered best interest for the public. Because of the marketing considerations pressure of public and competitive environment the parameters are required to do so by laws and regulations, businesses attempt to minimize or mitigate the negative effects that are associated with the value generating processes. These upgrades are frequently included in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). Many businesses establish CSR goals for themselves that are measured against a specific standard. By doing this, the businesses can identify the areas that need improvement, track their advancement, use various approaches the steps are developed for further improvement in the situation. Few of these indicators are influenced by the digitalization of technologies, and as this field of study advances, there are more ways to lessen the negative effects. It is commonly overlooked how much room digitization has to improve CSR metrics. Investment in area of application may be justified for big data potential and analytics and the generation of corporate social responsibility report under the various parameters are evaluated in the research study. The novelty of the present study is using big data analytics in CSR report through the designed framework for collection of data and big data capabilities for the creationof sustainable healthy environment globally.

articleTitle: Integration of Internet of Things, Data Sets, and Cloud computing towards Space-Science 5.0
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Technology has been influenced by the Internet of Things technology (IoT) in many different ways. It started as a network of interconnected devices communicating over the Internet has become tremendously complex system as network nodes were added and particular IoT domains were formed. There are numerous sub domains for IoT. IoT has yet to be implemented in a number of fields, including healthcare, robotics, and other related ones. one of the space research technologies that is advancing quickly. Over the past few decades, space research has grown significantly, with studies covering exo-planet discovery, colonization, space communication, and the potential for life on distant planets. In this study, we propose an unique Internet of Space Things (IoST) infrastructure that is cloud-compatible for the rapidly expanding and far-reaching field of space technology. The essay offers a thorough logical and physical architecture that takes into account ground stations, interstellar communication, public networks, cloud providers, enterprise networks, and cloud networks. The study will be helpful towards scientists and researchers working on IoT, emerging technologies, migration, robot assisted surgeries, space farming, etc.

articleTitle: A Cloud-Based Healthcare Diagnosis Support Network for Smart IoT for Predicting Chronic Kidney Failure
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: These days, cloud systems and the Internet of Things (IoT) are extensively used in a variety of medical services. Instead of relying on the limited storage and processing power found in mobile equipment, the vast amount of data generated by IoT equipment in the medical industry may be analysed on a cloud system. In this research, an internet healthcare judgment supporting platform for predicting chronic kidney disease (CR) is presented as a means of providing effective healthcare care. The data collection, preparation, and categorization of medical information are the three processes that the proposed model goes through in order to predict CKD. To categorise the data examples into CKD and non-CKD, the logistic regression (LR) method is used. Additionally, the Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) & adapt training rate optimisation algorithms are used to fine-tune the LR's settings. With the use of a reference CKD dataset, the effectiveness of the newly proposed model is evaluated. The test results showed that the provided model's better properties on the used dataset.

articleTitle: An investigation of the effects of the global epidemic on Crypto Currency returns and volatility
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In order to establish sustainable operations, Internet innovation has been widely adopted in the retail sector; however, certain operational difficulties, such as security and confidentiality have been uncovered in practice. As a result, linked fields must do more thorough theoretical study. In order to compete with online merchants and promote sustainable growth, this study examines how traditional brick and mortar stores might use IoT technology. First, by taking into account the costs of customer inconvenience associated with shopping through various retail partners and the influence of Technology, pricing Plans were created for the store and the retailer of concrete blocks, respectively. Furthermore, by contrasting different scenarios, the benefits of internet to retail shops and consumer excess are analysed. After that, the basic models were expanded to take into account consumer - perceived sensitivity regarding IoT technology and price competitiveness in order to test the robustness of the analytical conclusions. Additionally, actual data-based numerical analyses are performed. Smart metres, electric vehicles, rooftop solar photovoltaic panels, smart air conditioners, electric heating systems, and architectural usage of green protons and methyl in manufacturing applications, as well as control systems are all examples of how this decarbonization plan is now being implemented. This paper includes the details analysis of the adoption of this analytics software in the electricity system and associated connected sectors can have a favourable influence on numerous of the 17 sustainability agenda listed by the Unesco Institute of Economic Affairs.

articleTitle: The Importance of Big Data with in Telecommunications Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Organizations throughout every sector must cope with enormous amounts of data there in Big Data era. The need to comprehend how, how the fuck, and when Big Data Analytics (Analytic hierarchy process) technologies could serve as a useful tool for companies looking for a competitiveness has recently been highlighted by a number of professionals and experts. Due to the fact that there is still a substantial gap across skillsets and employee retention, investments in big data continue to lead to major problems. As a result, BDA benefits some businesses while neglecting to benefit others. A poll recently found that many firms devote the majority of their attention to data analysis, but just a small percentage use Big Data Analytics to identify consequences and perhaps even smaller use analytics tools to improve procedures and strategies. BDA is thus not often utilised, and therefore only a few businesses have benefited from it. This study focuses on the Erp system Principles (BDAP) in the hopes of gaining advantages via increased revenues and cost savings in to resolve this issue in the telecom industry and in front of the dearth of literature on the subject. Semi-structured interviews and field notes are two of the data gathering techniques used in this study's phenomenological case study design. The five essential components that support the endurance of BDAPs and their influence on firm productivity were proven by the Philips approach and the large number of materials that were performed.

articleTitle: The Role of Reconfigurable Intelligent Systems in a Win-Win Approach to 6G with Surfaces and Mobile Computing in Upcoming Wireless Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: An advantage of this methodology to sixth generation (6G) mobile systems is reconfigurable intelligence surface (RIS)-enabled communication. Enhancing the capacities, range, power generation, physical layer safety, & numerous other features of contemporary wireless connections is really the main goal of RIS-assisted communications. In addition, period, mobility edge computing (MEC), which expands a solitary cloud server's processing, communications, and cache abilities to an edge networks, has already demonstrated its enormous potential. In this post, we first give a general overview of the synergies between MEC and RIS. The next development of wireless network would undergo an unparalleled metamorphosis, in our opinion, as a result of the merging of MEC & RIS. Here on MEC-aided RIS which will advance wireless networks toward 6G, we offer a system view. We also list a few of the key difficulties that must be overcome while implementing MEC-aided RIS networking. Finally, the main MEC-assisted RIS correlated features are reviewed.

articleTitle: Ensuring Security in Internet of Everything (IoT) With Smart Sensor Networking and Mobile Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)

articleTitle: Benefits of Implementing an Ad-Hoc Network for Hospitality Businesses with IoT Smart Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: As a result of digitization, the barriers between policy and engineering have blurred, making way for new types of businesses to emerge that use digital technologies and management practices. The purpose of the proposed research was to examine how IoT and Big Data factor into the digital transformation processes of various companies. It is argued in this study that the proliferation of IoT devices and Big Information has led to a chaotic tangle of information. To sort through the clutter, researchers conducted a literature study of articles covering the period from 2008 to 2019 that looked at the intersection of IoT and Big Data. The findings reveal that Internet of Things (IoT) and Big Data play a predominate role in reengineering corporate processes, goods, and services; nevertheless, a lack of public understanding and acceptance has caused research to progress along many, inconsistent pathways. This research has important ramifications for company managers and marketers since it shows how Big Data and Internet of Things are facilitating a digital revolution that is improving many areas of operation. With the goal of guiding future research and practice, this paper examines Big Data and Internet of Things (IoT) as two sides of the same coin.

articleTitle: Towards Realization of an IoT Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Autonomous and Supported Lifestyle (AAL) has been highlighted as a requirement in today's environment in a number of theories, techniques, and different uses for the Internet of Things. (IoT). Technologies standardization initiatives like Wireless V4.x (Wireless smart), for example, have sparked a meteoric rise in creative relatively brief wireless devices that can provide a variety of services to AAL. Additionally, new potential for major carrier is created by enabling equipment (Sq.m) connectivity between all of these technologies. To support M2M exchanges, telecommunications companies, especially telecom companies, might have to build new infrastructure and rethink their corporate objectives. Simple Square meters or IoT products often need another suitable tool, like a telephone, to serve as a doorway to the World wide web in order to function to their fullest capacity. The unique Concept of Iot examined in this study enables any nearby Innertubes device to serve as an M2M entry point for Internet of things. As a result, the user of a Sensor node no longer has to own a smartphone or other Innertubes equipment in order to access capabilities like internet - based. In this research, an unique IoT architectural prototype system for short-range signal repeaters is described. The test bed's installation, benefits and drawbacks, and sampling analysis using data acquired from a real-world event are discussed, and the findings are positive.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology for Secured Transactions in Banking
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Customers who use internet banking have the flexibility to manage their assets sometimes when and wherever they choose. Any web-based transactions will, in any instance, be vulnerable to privacy risks. The current system makes use of two-way validation factors (OTP), which are easily cracked by cybercriminals, causing customers to have their personal information invaded without having access to the aggressor's recognised evidence. As a result, in this research, we suggest a flexible SIM sequential-based check approach to safeguard mobile transactions using a waiter-side secure platform built on the Blockchain. The customer's record has the supporter character module (sim) serial number, and if a gate crasher tries to initiate a transaction from another sim, there is a mix-up of the login credentials, at which point the system communicates the intrusive location information to the bank. The bank then sends an email to the subscribed customer alerting them to the peculiarities of the intruder. There is no risk of a gate crasher initiating the transaction from another device because the mobile sim chronicle number is unique to the sim and isn't literally very distanced, eliminating the concerns associated with OTP. By verifying the updated markings throughout the transaction and calculating the contract for transaction confirmation, the Ethereum Blockchain breakthrough provides server-side information base security. For reliable financial exchange, blockchain-based security is mathematically validated.

articleTitle: An Assessment of the Fundamental Concepts of Blockchain Technology and its Application in Cryptocurrency using Bibliometric Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In past few years, blockchain has attracted attention as a potential area of study on a worldwide scale. It is a decentralized database system that is both autonomous and unreliable. Since its first implementation, blockchain technology has been used by a growing number of nations and academic institutions. In order to get a broad understanding of blockchain technology and the present research focus, this article makes use of the quantitative analysis tools CiteSpace. For this study, we relied heavily on data from the Web of Sciences core collection dataset. The studies included 1000 publications published between 2015 and 2022. To be more precise, the patterns and fields of publishing may provide information on the directions and foci of recent blockchain studies. This bibliometric study included the most prominent and prolific writers, universities, nations, and publications. Smart contracts, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin and cryptography were the most popular theoretical and research issues related to blockchain technology. To identify developing tendencies and new frontiers in blockchain, a keyword-based cluster analysis was conducted. The findings of this study demonstrate the growing interest in blockchain technology and its potential applications in various domains, including cryptocurrency. The analysis also identified key research areas and gaps in the literature that can guide future research in this field. Overall, this paper provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of research on blockchain technology and cryptocurrency and contributes to the growing body of knowledge on this topic.

articleTitle: Upcoming Possibilities for Data 6G: Vision and Design Developments
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Internet of Thing (IoT) systems using sixth generation (6G) wireless systems, including such haptic feedback, social contact, and expanded realities, have a wide range of requirements for latencies, dependability, bit rate, and consumer performance measures. In terms of managing, run, and optimize the 6Portable wireless network and its core IoT service, it is necessary to create a new structure in order to enable IoT programs over 6G. Digital twins (DT) can serve as the foundation for this type of new 6G infrastructure. The 6G physical system is portrayed virtually by DTs, which also include the techniques, modern communications, computer processing platforms, & confidentiality and safety technicians. The primary design objectives are presented first. Firstly, we outline the essential design specifications for utilizing a DT to enable 6G. Then, design patterns and elements including edge-cloud-based twins, cloud-based twins, and advantage twins are discussed. We also give a comparative description of different twins. Lastly, we present and suggest suggestions for a number of potential future study trajectories.

articleTitle: A Blockchain Based Framework for Opening Up Big Data in Collaborative Edges with Less Resource Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)

articleTitle: A Detailed Review and Study of Implementation of Security System Design for Machine Learning-Based Software Systems: Issues And Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The rapidly growing technology specially in the field of software, Machine Learning (ML) has played an important role in a range of tasks, including voice, video, and computer vision. It is currently being utilised in software systems to automate the crucial processes more and more. Machine learning-based modern software systems (MLBSS) are currently difficult to build safely, which will severely limit the uses in security and safety-critical domains. Recently, majority of articles are published and still research work is going on the safety problems for ML and Deep Learning (DL), which place a strong prominence on the models and data both, adversaries’ threats have been taken into consideration. In this paper, we address the prospect that system bugs or external adversarial assaults might lead to security vulnerabilities for machine learning-based software systems, and we propose that safe development techniques ought to be applied throughout the whole lifecycle. We conclude by providing a thorough study of the security for MLBSS, which includes a comprehensive analysis based on a review of the structure of three distinctive features in terms of security issues. The entire state-of-the-art for MLBSS secure development is also provided.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Early Diagnosis of Sepsis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Sepsis is a major killer of those who are already in a serious condition. The morbidity and death rates in this field remain high, despite the fact that medical technology has been advancing steadily over the last several years. This is due mostly to people not beginning therapy quickly enough and doctors not following best practices. Medical decision support solutions have advanced greatly with the help of artificial intelligence (AI), a rapidly developing sector in the medical industry. Great promise has been shown in its ability to anticipate patients' clinical conditions and aid clinical decision-making. Early prediction, prognosis evaluation, mortality prediction, and optimum treatment are just few of the areas where algorithms developed using artificial intelligence may be put to use. This article summarizes the most recent research on AI based clinical decision support in sepsis as well as explains how this cutting-edge technology might aid in sepsis prediction, identification, sub phenotyping, prognostic evaluation, and clinical treatment. We also spoke about the difficulties of using this non-conventional approach in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Systems For Identifying And Segmenting Facial Labels
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: To perform precise facial labelling, we suggest an edge-to-edge identification method in this study. According to their cutting-edge efficiency, fully convolutional networks have replaced other common algorithms in the domain of semantic categorization. Nevertheless, a broad FCN typically yields uniform and slick outcomes. Additionally, characteristics for some subcategories cannot be properly examined by FCN whenever the semantics categorization in collections, such as the face classification issue, is excessively imbalanced. To solve these issues, a pyramidal FCN initially encodes a face picture into multi-level characteristic mappings. Next, the characteristics of the various facial characteristics are retrieved independently using the enclosing box that a one-stage detecting head provides. The retrieved characteristics are processed by 3 category sub-networks to produce the appropriate segmentation accuracy. Direct decoding of the layer of skin is possible first from pyramidal FCN's rear end. The total segmented output is then produced by integrating the several sections. Furthermore, the suggested approach, which was tested on a database with only one face labelled row, may be utilized immediately to carry out complex multi-facial classification tasks without requiring any networking modifications or extra modules or data. With a modest size of the networking, the entire system can be taught from beginning to finish (12 MB). Studies demonstrate that the suggested strategy can produce more precise (one or multiple) facial labelling outcomes in comparison to earlier efforts and achieves cutting-edge outcomes inside the HELEN facial database..

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Material Selection in Construction 4.0: A Comparative Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The construction industry is rapidly evolving with the advent of Industry 4.0, and one significant area of transformation is material selection. Choosing the right construction materials is a crucial factor in achieving high-performance and sustainable buildings. However, with the sheer number of available materials, it can be a challenging task to select the most suitable one for a specific application. This study explores how artificial intelligence (AI) technologies can revolutionize material selection in Construction 4.0. We conduct a comparative analysis of AI-based approaches such as supervised and unsupervised learning, decision trees, neural networks, and K-means clustering algorithms, as well as principal component analysis. We examine their benefits, drawbacks, and suitability for different material selection scenarios. Furthermore, we provide a mathematical justification for their use in material selection. Neural networks can learn nonlinear models to identify patterns in a database and suggest optimal construction materials based on identified attributes and boundary conditions. Clustering algorithms can help in creating innovative designs by grouping constituents with similar functionality or working conditions. Our study highlights the potential of AI-based approaches to improve material selection in the construction industry by reducing time, costs, and errors associated with manual selection methods. With the use of AI technologies, developers can make informed decisions about selecting the best resources for their construction projects, ultimately leading to the creation of high-performance, sustainable buildings.

articleTitle: The Design and implementation of a double layered Security Network with an Authentication System through Block chain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With more and more connected devices joining IoT networks, protecting their communications is becoming more difficult. The distributed ledger technology known as blockchain has the potential to solve the security issues plaguing 5G-enabled IoT networks. This article provides a layered blockchain security strategy to protect Internet of Things networks and make their deployment simpler. Using clustering, the complex multi-layer structure is simplified. The K-unknown clusters in the IoT network are generated by use of a hybrid Evolutionary Computation Methodology involving Simulated Annealing and Genetic Algorithms. The chosen cluster chiefs have authority over local authentication and permissions. By creating a private blockchain network on a local level, cluster administrators and critical nodes can streamline their interactions. This type of blockchain also facilitates authentication on a network, but it also adds an extra layer of security and integrity. The proposed framework makes use of Hyperledger Fabric, an open-source implementation of Distributed ledger technology. The encryption of data transmitted between nodes is ensured by the use of a global distributed ledger technology, which is instated in the base stations. As opposed to previously disclosed methods, simulation results show that the proposed clustering algorithm is effective. Finally, it is shown that the envisaged portable cryptocurrency architecture achieves a better latency/capacity tradeoff than a conventional global blockchain.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for Statistical Analysis of Customer Satisfaction in Service Management
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This research paper aims to analyze customer satisfaction data in service management, with a focus on identifying key drivers of customer satisfaction and areas for improvement. The research was conducted using a survey method, where a sample of 1000 customers from different service industries were asked to rate their satisfaction with various aspects of the service provided. The data was collected using a standardized questionnaire and analyzed using statistical methods, including descriptive statistics, inferential statistics, and linear regression analysis. The results of the research indicate that the most important drivers of customer satisfaction in service management are timeliness, competence of staff, and quality of service. The results also reveal that there are significant differences in customer satisfaction across different service industries. The findings of this research will be useful for service managers to identify areas for improvement and to develop strategies to enhance customer satisfaction.
