articleTitle: A Structural Equation Modeling Approach for HPC Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: High-performance computing (HPC) is becoming increasingly important in modern technology as a means of accelerating difficult mathematical calculations and business processes in several industries. Because of this, conducting research on big data and making use of cloud computing are prerequisites for putting "high-performance computing" into action in the real world. The purpose of the research was to determine, on the basis of the benefits, the benefits and drawbacks of HPC systems as well as cloud computing. The SEM approach was utilized throughout the research in order to justify the procedure for successfully adopting HPC. For the purpose of this investigation, the SPSS statistical software was utilized to carry out multiple regression analyses.In statistical analysis, a relationship is said to be "significant" if the significance value is less than 0.05, indicating that there is a close connection between the dependent and independent variables. The high-potential cohort in the industry and the year were chosen as the independent variables, and "Profit Gain" was chosen as the dependent variable. The findings demonstrated that there was no significant connection between the dependent and the independent variable. The results of the SPSS data show that the factors that were chosen do not have a substantial impact, and the regression analysis demonstrates that the data does not fulfil the requirements either.

articleTitle: An Investigation of Block Chains for Attaining Sustainable Society
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: It's possible to define blockchain technology as the DLT-based technology upon which cryptocurrencies and other distributed ledgers rely. This innovation extends well beyond Bitcoin and other forms of digital money. With its help, a new Internet era may dawn in which sensitive information can be sent, stored, and managed without fear of tampering or other forms of corruption. Because of its potential to combat corruption and help the impoverished, among other things, this technology is worth investing in. Any kind of transaction, such as the sale of a home or a stock, may be tracked nearly instantly. Sustainable development is at the heart of today's modern world. Technology like this may be useful in the pursuit of sustainability, which involves improving the here and now without jeopardizing the future. To be really useful, though, this innovation requires a robust digital governance structure. The purpose of this article is to investigate Blockchain Technology as a tool for promoting long-term, environmentally friendly growth in India, and to identify contexts where it may be particularly useful. How the Indian economy may adopt this technology and incorporate it into its system to achieve Sustainable Development is the topic of my paper. Capital market, accountable production and consumption, environmental protection, providing legal identity for everybody, property registration, and transparent philanthropy are all possible applications of this technology in India. The research methods used in this paper are entirely inductive, with a focus on secondary sources of information.

publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)

articleTitle: Digital Secure Storage for Healthcare Data Information Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Healthcare Blockchains grant access to a modern technique to accumulate healthcare information, achieve healthcare, and make a belief for medical records distribution and records combination in a decentralized unlock healthcare network surroundings. Even though the healthcare blockchain technologies have paid attention to extroverted benefits in addition to a concentration in assiduousness, management as well as university circles, the safety and confidentiality concerns stay behind the center of attention of deliberate while organizing Blockchains for information sharing across company operations and research collaboration in the healthcare sector. Medical data sharing via Blockchains are the subject of research that focuses on security and privacy needs. Together with technological solution techniques and strategies, the research provides a complete evaluation of the safety and confidentiality risks, requirements, and technology solutions. In the beginning, we discuss the security and privacy requirements for using healthcare Blockchains to share electronic medical records. Second, we group current initiatives into three reference blockchain procedure scenarios for the sharing of electronic medical records. We consider the technologies that can be used to implement this secure store for healthcare data properties in the two categories of healthcare Blockchains procedure scenarios, including anonymous signatures, and attribute-based encryption. Source to implement the access control for hospital, patient, doctor, admin.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in DL-based Text Summarization: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The technique of creating a brief and relevant summary of a lengthy piece of text while retaining its vital content and overall relevance is known as text summarization. It involves condensing the original text while retaining its core message. In today's age of information overload, text summarization has gained immense significance as we encounter an excessive amount of textual information on a daily basis. Text summarization can be done manually by humans, but it can also be automated using ML techniques. DL models have demonstrated promising results in text summarization in recent years, and have become a major study area in the field of NLP. This study offers a synopsis of literature on the use of DL approaches for text summarization. The review covers various techniques such as CNN, RNN, LSTM, DeepSum, GA2C, Pointer Generator, and BERT, as well as various datasets such as CNN/Daily Mail and Arabic datasets. The ROUGE Score was used to assess the efficacy of text summarizing approaches, and BERT received the highest score of 98%. This study gives a detail examination of the current advantage in DL approaches for text summarization. Furthermore, it indicates possible new study areas in this subject.

articleTitle: One-Shot Learning Methodology For Plant Leaf Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Plant diseases are a significant challenge in the agriculture and farming sector, leading to reduced crop yields and lower-quality produce. This issue can exacerbate poverty and food scarcity. Deep Learning has shown promise in computer vision tasks, including disease identification and detection in plants. However, the limited variety of datasets available for different plants and diseases is a major obstacle. One-Shot Learning (OSL), a subfield of meta-learning, can be used to address this challenge when few or limited datasets for specific plants are available. OSL has been employed in other domains such as face and symbol recognition, but its application in plant and disease detection remains relatively underexplored. In this study, we presented several methodologies that can produce an accurate OSL model for plants with limited datasets. OSL employs Siamese Networks and triplet loss functions to create a model that can identify an unknown object or category with just one sample. This approach has the potential to reduce processing time and energy consumption, lower costs associated with massive data storage, and provide farmers with a valuable tool to quickly identify and treat plant diseases. The proposed methodologies aim to significantly improve the accuracy of OSL models for plants with fewer datasets. Furthermore, the use of functions such as the triplet loss function and metric learning is critical for the OSL to perform effectively. Overall, the study demonstrates the potential of OSL as a powerful tool for plant disease detection and has important implications for improving crop yields and addressing food scarcity.

articleTitle: An empirical study on application of 5G smart system in education
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: All facets of society, such as education, have been disrupted by the social estrangement brought on by the Covid-19 epidemic. We must respond rapidly to this circumstance in order to sustain routine activities. Several organizations and systems have hurried to provide assistance for users. In order to consider the elements that can contribute to the premature implementation of 5G smart learning technologies, this paper employs a critical viewpoint. This study offers a conceptual approach built on the technology acceptance models (TAM) that incorporates elements from the social practice hypothesis to analyse students' attitudes concerning smart learning (SPT). We discovered that the decision of 5G smart technologies relies on the integrated consequences of Material (MAA), Meanings (MEA), and Competency access (COA) elements by SEM of research (n=300) undertaken in China. The findings show that these are the important variables influencing students' inclinations to use 5G smart education technologies. These findings are meant to help decision-makers and service distributors devise practical strategies for boosting the usage of smart learning. These results can help us create and properly offer smart learning programmes in other nations, as well as highlight obstacles to smart learning uptake.

articleTitle: Perspectives of machine learning on protein structure prediction and function
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The experimental techniques for determining protein structure using electron microscopy and other various methods. These are all laborious, time-consuming processes that call for knowledge. Using data gathered in the protein libraries and computational approaches, scientists employ prediction tools to make the process less time-consuming. Machine learning techniques have piqued the community's interest in structure prediction in recent years. The majority strategies off machine learning helps in protein structure prediction and function focus on co-evolutionary techniques. The quantity of homologous protein sequences present in the databases affects how accurate these methods are. Many proteins experience difficulty with the prediction challenge, particularly those with a dearth of sequence homologs. Without using any assumptions, deep learning techniques enable the extraction of complex features from protein sequence data. Protein structures that are accurately predicted are used to create antibodies, study protein-protein interactions, and develop new drugs. This article reviews methods for predicting protein structure and function using machine learning.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology Implementation In Various Governance Domains: A Systematic Review Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Technological integration in various fields yielded the proponents of the Internet of Things that matured the concept of Blockchain. This Blockchain technology is an emerging path for a decentralized economy, secure transactions and proposing transparency in vast aspects of business points and activities. The success of the implementation of novel technology relies on the acceptance and usage behavior which in return orchestrates the enablers and barriers of implementation. This study aims to understand the implementation of Blockchain in different domains through acceptance mechanisms that were overlooked in previous literature. For this purpose, numerous studies on the acceptance and adoption of Blockchain are considered to investigate the vital factors and aspects that support the implementation process. Various domains were pondered and classified for research inferences, including supply chain, finance, governance, banking, construction, etc. The research has provided an overview of Blockchain implementation from the end-user’s perspective, which would be resourceful for stakeholders to fortify the concerning elements for a better outcome. The research inferences will support scholarly advances in Blockchain towards business development. The research will also provide the platform to overview the research on Blockchain through a multidisciplinary lens that would contribute to a novel interpretation of this emerging arena.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach to Predict Prostate Cancer by IPCA Analysis with Boosting and Bagging Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A malignant cancer that develops in the prostate gland of men is known as prostate cancer. The small and fuzzy shaped nature of the lesion makes it challenging for the development of a reliable detection tool. Of late, the magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is the most popular method for diagnosing prostate cancer. However, obtaining data with genuine values is very scarce which renders the techniques for diagnosing prostate cancer using MRI imaging even more difficult. This research suggests a new method of prostate cancer screening based on magnetic resonance imaging (MR) called ProCDet to overcome these obstacles. Prostate MR image registration, prostate segmentation, and prostate cancer lesion segmentation are the three components that make up the method. Initially, MR image sequences are registered with one another to establish their spatial relationship. By segmenting the prostate with the help of the designated functional, we can reduce the impact of irrelevant data. Finally, a 3D prostate cancer lesion segmentation network based on Focal Tversky Loss is employed to pinpoint the disease's specific location. In addition, an internal learning technique is proposed in this study to enhance the accuracy of prostate cancer detection by making full use of unlabelled prostate data. Experimental confirmation of the suggested ProCDet is provided on the ProstateX dataset. With a median false-positive rate of 0.6384 lesions per patient, the overall accuracy is 93.74%. Experiments demonstrate that the ProCDet can detect targets at state-of-the-art level.

articleTitle: Implementation of smart future cities with big data analytics integrated with cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Many cities and towns have recently formed aspirations to become smart cities. These networks are attempting to implement the smart city concept in order to better increase supportability, inhabitant personal satisfaction, and financial outcomes. The concept of a "smart city" focuses on utilising cutting-edge technologies to improve several administrations and endeavours, including transportation, energy, healthcare, and education, as well as to more effectively utilise the city's resources and foster new economic opportunities.. One of the promising instruments to help with these endeavors is big data innovation. Smart cities can make better decisions by using big data that has been amassed through time in many different businesses. This study distinguishes the various dynamic methods used in smart cities. This design empowers the incorporation of different advances, for example, fog registering and distributed computing, to help the various scientific and decision-making processes expected to completely use the big data right now accessible. Numerous big data applications can thusly involve these administrations in the smart city and use them for different targets.

articleTitle: A Technique Based on Ensemble Machine Learning for The Analysis of Electronic Nose Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Numerous applications have been documented for electronic nose (e-nose) devices, which are valued for their speed, affordability, and lack of invasiveness. The e-nose scheme is a useful instrument for analyzing volatile chemicals as a distinct 'fingerprint,' especially in the meat industry. The pattern identification algorithm's capacity to decode e-nose signals is crucial to the e-nose system's effectiveness in a wide variety of uses. However, positive results using ensemble approaches have been reported in a number of data types. In this study, an ensemble learning strategy is proposed for e-nose signal analysis, particularly for evaluating beef quality. Not only are learning algorithms and sensor array optimization using ensemble approaches. Ensemble FSA is created by combining three filter-based feature selection algorithms (FSAs)—reliefF, chi-square, and Gini index—for sensor array optimization. When using a single FSA on a collection of homogenous e-nose data for beef quality monitoring, it is common for the results to be inconsistent or unexpected. In addition, multi-class regression and categorization problems are handled by using ensemble learning techniques. We use bagging and boosting algorithms, shown here by Random Forest (RF) and Adaboost. Both a support vector machine (SVM) and a decision tree are used as independent learners, and their results are compared to those of the ensemble. Experiments show that our ensemble method is effective and generalizable for e-nose signal processing. Optimized sensor combination using filter-based FSA consistently outperforms previous methods in both classification and regression. Additionally, despite using a reduced sensor complement, Adaboost as a boosting algorithm yields the highest quality prediction.

articleTitle: Machine Learning as A Predictive Technology and its Impact on Digital Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) Approach is a prospective methodology that is frequently employed within global production, branding, economics, transit, and aviation today. The global banking markets of today have had a significant influence on several facets of digitized pricing. Large firms employ a variety of digitized pricing strategies to produce the highest revenue margins possible despite undertaking international commerce. On the opposite side, successful machine learning applications provide important benefits in the global digital markets. It has been determined that companies may trade revenue over digital channels more easily and at a lower cost with the usage of ML methods as they previously could. Additionally, machine learning may quickly enhance overall trade approaches in digital pricing marketplaces to increase profits and provide flexible company knowledge for upcoming experimentation. Using a supplementary approach and subject-related questionnaires, investigators will explore the research design issue with an efficient quantifiable way. Utilizing a variety of cutting-edge ML technologies to improve the effectiveness of digital pricing has gotten simpler in the current sharing marketplaces. In order to expand the area of future study, the research article provides certain significant insight into the effects of ML techniques and associated applications to digital pricing. This feature has a significant influence on and simplifies an organisation's fundamental judgement processes. However little available about managers' attitudes towards it and awareness of machine learning (ML) technologies, as well as their uptake and deployment to enhance both strategic and operational management, according to the information gaps study. This study that is being provided herein focused on how marketing departments, news businesses, & advertising can use employ ML-driven tools. A sampling of all these organisations that operate in Czechoslovakia was the subject of a qualitative and quantitative study. The results highlight: 1) the significance of intelligent analytical tools in the development and application of marketing techniques; 2) the ignorance of technological innovations, such as machine learning (ML) and intelligent systems (AI); 3) The minimal degree of acceptance & usage of ML-driven analysis tools in marketing, as well as 4) the prospective applicability of ML technologies in business. Thus, the aim of this paper involves discussing the concept of machine learning as a predictive technology and evaluating its impact on the digital markets. In order to achieve the research, aim and objectives, a thorough research methodology has been included in this study. At the end a brief conclusion has been drawn by considering all findings and facts together. Furthermore, to assist businesses in locating prospects & carrying out initiatives focused on the application and acceptance of critical ML tools in digital advertising, a framework made up of accelerators and a flow diagram was established.

articleTitle: PM2.5 Level Forecasting using Transformer-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Air pollution is a significant public well-being concern in Indian cities, and forecasting PM 2.5 levels is important for effective air quality control. In this paper, we present a novel technique for PM2.5 level forecasting using transformer-based models, specifically the encoder part of the Transformer with modifications employed for the prediction of the concentration levels of PM2.5 particles using the previous years of data available to us. The proposed model makes use of historical PM 2.5 data to make predictions for multiple cities in India. Our experimental results indicate that the presented model surpasses previously used time series forecasting methods, achieving average error of 7.69% on the test set. Additionally, the given model can comprehend the complex temporal dependencies in the data and handle missing values effectively. These results demonstrate the potential of transformer-based models for PM2.5 level forecasting in Indian cities and have important implications for air quality management and public health policy.

articleTitle: Human Voice Artificial Intelligence in Education, Illustrate and Prospective Possibilities
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: One use of artificial intelligence is natural language processing (NLP). Voice assistants are able to have conversations with individuals in their native language and include AI by using cloud computing. Voice assistants are now included into millions of different consumer products due to the ease with which they may be used. Voice assistant-enabled smart speakers are among the most popular consumer electronics devices now available, but universities and other types of organizations have just lately started using them. The purpose of this paper is twofold: first, to offer a review of previous research on speech recognition in the classroom, and second, to provide fresh discoveries.

articleTitle: The Development and Implementation of Deep Learning-Based Pneumonia Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The most common cause of death worldwide is pneumonia. It affects 7% of the planet's population &, on average, results in the deaths of 700, 000 children annually. Using X-rays as the primary diagnostic tool, this disease is identified. Using principles of Transfer Learning & Image Augmentation, we have developed a wholly original image processing-based Deep Learning technique to identify respiratory problems. With a memory score of 97.44% and also a precision score of 96.00%, we were generally prepared to succeed. In this program, the patient must attach a chest X-ray that's been acquired by the laboratory. The computer will then examine the report for errors and, if any are found, will alert the patient that something is wrong with their health. Additionally, the system will display the message "Healthy" if indeed the report has no issues. By adopting this technique, the patient can avoid spending more money to see a doctor if they are not experiencing any pneumonia-related issues. Additionally, patients may save money in this way.

Author Keywords: and educational techniques are examples of pc diagnostics

articleTitle: The Administration, Analysis, and Potential for Innovation of Big Data as it Relates to Present and Future uses in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Vast volumes of info, or "big data," have amazing potential. Due of the immense potential it has, it has received particular attention during the last 20 years. To enhance the operations they deliver, several public and private companies produce, manage, and analyses big data. Official records, individual patient history, test findings, and world wide web of things-enabled devices are just a few of the big data sources used in the medical field.Big data pertinent to health care is also produced in great quantities by the physiological science field. To produce helpful information from this data, effective administration and assessment are necessary. Instead, trying to discover a remedy via big data analysis rapidly resembles trying to locate a haystack of needles. Every stage of processing large data comes with a unique set of difficulties that can only be overcome by adopting powerful processing technology for big data analysis. Medical practitioners must be fully provided with the architecture to regularly create and analyses big data in order to offer timely solutions for enhancing public wellness. By creating new opportunities for contemporary medical, effective big data administration, analysis, and interpretations may completely alter the game. That is precisely the reason why a variety of sectors, including that of the health care industry, are moving aggressively to transform this capability into improved financial and service benefits. The medical treatments and customised medicine may be revolutionized by contemporary healthcare organizations with a logic and facts of health care and biomedical data.

Author Keywords: Quantum Analysis and Big Data Analysis

articleTitle: IoT Implementation in Various Applications: A Detailed Review of Cyber Security Issues and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Data must be protected against cybercrime as the network revolution grows and becomes more complicated. With the purpose to intentionally damage sensitive and secret information, cybercrimes cost the world economy billions of dollars. Because these crimes are perpetrated often, it is vital to increase cyberspace security to lessen and perhaps even prevent the effects of cybercrime. The internet of things (IoT) phenomena is now the subject of study, as privacy and safety are acknowledged as the primary concerns for Iot., particularly in light of the fact that they are being used in crucial contexts like healthcare systems. The current state of safety in the IoT sector is examined in this paper, along with security-related problems. We look at particular security needs and methods for resolving these problems. IoT safety is being recognised as a problem that blockchains may help with.

articleTitle: Differentiation in Medical Practise using Sophisticated Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The phrase “big data” has been used characterize the exponential increase in both the variation, and mobility of data available in practically every area of our life for more than ten years, not only in drug development. As experts, we can now quickly produce, store, and analyze data that would've obviously done several centuries to assemble. Big data, therefore, has changed from what it originally meant. The phrase today encompasses n't only large amounts of information but also our growing capacity for data analysis and interpretation. Axioms like “business intelligence” and “big data” have developed to define methods for dealing with the expanding quantity of data that is already accessible. Although perhaps not necessarily by or for doctors and scientists, new techniques aimed at enhancing data collecting, storing, clearing, computing, and evaluation are constantly being discovered. Utilizing new technologies to interpret value from massive amounts of data has the opportunity to lead to real reform in clinical care, from general monitoring to electronic medical records miners to personalized treatment and smarter medication creation. Every time latest technique guarantees “Big Developments,” there are still big problems. Here, we address the advantages and disadvantages that our growing capacity to handle massive information presents to basic science. A standardization of transmitted data, genre, and interventional descriptors is necessary. There is also a greater need for multilateral organizations with the dissemination of information and knowledge and experience. But possibly the biggest obstacle is the desire to reevaluate whether and when explanatory procedure is trained to scientists and doctors. We also put “Big data” studies into perspective: recent developments could seem to herald a revolutionary that would overturn traditional medical research paradigms. Nonetheless, rather than replacing traditional theory procedures, they actually hold more potential when used in conjunction with them. Rigorous standards assessment and field tests will always be needed for the production of fresh, data-driven concepts built on easily understood frameworks. Therefore, research hypotheses work built on massive datasets complements conventional theory science but instead of replacing it. Both may be used to enhance therapeutic interventions, and each can learn from the other.

articleTitle: Facial Attributes Recognised From Partial Faces Using Segment-Based Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Modern methods for identifying attributes from faces nearly invariably presuppose the existence of a whole, unobstructed face. As a result, their performance deteriorates for obscured and partially viewable faces. We propose SPLITFACE, the deep convolutional p2p technique in this article that is specifically created to carry out attribute recognition in partial occlusion faces. The suggested method uses a statistics methodology to identify which qualities are localised in which facial segments, using a number of facesections& the entire facial as input. Due to the network's distinctive architecture, which enables several segments to forecast each attribute, committee machine approaches can be used to combine local and global judgements to improve efficiency. By needing to rely just on existence of the entire face, SPLITFACE can accurately forecast those traits that are localised in the visible sections of the face. For benchmark analyses, we employ the LFWA and CelebA facial attribute databases. In order to assess how well attribute detection techniques perform on partial faces, we also change both datasets by masking the faces. Our analysis demonstrates that SPLITFACE performs noticeably better than other previous approaches, particularly for partial faces.

articleTitle: Recent Modelling of the Ownership Structures and It’s Role in Corporate Performance of Company
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This examination unique spotlights on the relationship between ownership structure and company execution, which has been a subject of interest for the two specialists and professionals. The literature review highlights several studies that have examined this relationship in different contexts. Overall, the literature suggests that ownership concentration positively impacts firm performance, while state ownership has a negative effect. Additionally, the effectiveness of ownership structure depends on the context, mechanisms, and outcomes of corporate governance, and is influenced by institutional factors such as legal systems, financial markets, and cultural norms. These findings have significant design implications, and implementation of ownership structures in companies, as well as for policy- makers who seek to promote efficient and effective corporate governance. Recent research has shown that ownership structures can significantly impact the corporate performance of a company. Social Network Analysis (SNA) has emerged as a powerful tool for examining the relationships between shareholders and their influence on decision-making processes within a company. This paper proposes a research model that uses SNA to analyze ownership structures and their impact on corporate performance. The model will test the hypothesis that the centrality of key shareholders in the ownership structure has a significant impact on the corporate performance of a company. This study reveals that auxiliary companies tend to be associated with NUTS 3 regions that exhibit lower GDP and fewer patent applications compared to their parent companies.

articleTitle: The Integration of Machine Learning Technique with the Existing System to Predict the Flight Prices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The cost of airline tickets fluctuates depending on a number of variables, together with the scheduling, destination, and length of the flight. By using machine learning algorithms to the gathered ancient flight data, the suggested scheme will generate a prediction model. It might be difficult for consumers to decide when is the best time to buy plane tickets, mostly because they lack the knowledge necessary to make predictions regarding price changes. In this project, our main goals were to identify underlying trends in travel costs in India byancient data and to recommend the most advantageous time to purchase a ticket.A comparative study of several methods in determining the ideal time to purchase anaircraft ticket and the expanse that may be saved if completed so is conducted as part of the research in order to validate or refute common misconceptions about the airline business. Surprisingly, the route, month, day (holiday or working day), time, commercial airlinetransporter, and day of departure all have a significant impact on price trends. While prices on some highly competitive routes, such as those between metropolitan to metropolitan cities like Mumbai and Delhi, increased in a non-decreasing tendency as the number of days until departure reduced, other paths, such as those between metropolitan and non-metropolitan cities like Delhi and Guwahati, had a set period of time during which fares are at their lowermost.According to the availability of previous data aircraft carriers operating in India are divided into two fundamental groups namely the opulent and economical group. Majority of times, the trip with the lowest fare belonged to the economical group. The statistics also confirmed that there are times of the day when prices are predicted to be at their highest. To significantly reduce the cost of purchasing flights across the Indian domestic airline market, the project's scope might be greatly expanded across the numerous routes.

articleTitle: Blockchain Exploratory Analysis in Strategic Management
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With the use of consensus mechanism, cryptocurrency, and accurate asset tracking, block chain technology, is a peer regulated framework. The current methods of doing business in the construction industry might be drastically altered by adopting a distributed database system. The construction sector has frequently been criticized for its delayed adoption of new technology through its supply networks in a way that is not efficient. Widespread fragmentation, outdated supply chain, harmful competitive pressure, a lack of collaboration and accountability, slim profit margins, and a dearth of human assets are all often mentioned as major contributors. Through an explorative approach, this paper examines ways to get construction supply chains ready for blockchain technology as it gains traction in many other sectors, including finance and banking. Focus groups and moderately discussions with 17 subject specialists helped gather the study's empirical data. The study also provides a SWOT (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats) analysis and outlines the prerequisites and processes toward a Blockchain-enabled building supply structure.

articleTitle: A Review on Challenges, Opportunities, And Solutions For 5th Generation Based IoT Using Blockchain & AI
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT), which connects billions of electrical gadgets over the internet, has completely transformed the digital world. In the present day, as traditional equipment become more autonomous and intelligent, IoT devices are crucial. Increased data transfer is one major problem where 5 g networks world is crucial. However, these Internet of Things (IoT) devices utilizecentralized architecture-based protocols, which may result in a number of security risks for the data. Virtual reality, autonomous robotics, self-driving cars, and security difficulties may all be resolved by integrating artificial intelligence with 5G wireless infrastructure. The main goal of the system is to increase user confidence without relying on external authority. Blockchain has become a crucial technology that keeps track of the network’s event records via a distributed ledger. For IoT devices, blockchain offers a safe, decentralized, and trustworthy ecosystem. IoT and blockchain integration, however, is not without its difficulties. For instance, poor throughput is a key problem. IoT devices need a substantially greater throughput than the 12 to 15 transactions per second that the Ethereum blockchain network can currently handle. On light of this, blockchains are unable to function in an IoT-based 5G network. The blockchain’s network is the factor that restricts throughput. The P2P network’s delayed transaction and block propagation prevents miners and verifiers from quickly mining and, respectively, verifying new blocks. Therefore, the main problem with IoT-based blockchains is network scalability. That is in our past work, we utilized a dispersed blockchain organization to defeat the issue of organization versatility, and in this article, we utilize the Pontoon agreement technique to help the throughput of the blockchain. Security is one more essential worry with IoT organizations. Unfortunately, the blockchain’s dispersed records are available to general society and delicate information is open to anyone on the organization; in any case, in these conditions, outsider altering isn't possible without uncovering the first items. We utilized zkLedger, a zero-information based cryptography-based arrangement, to address security challenges.

articleTitle: IoT Narrow Band for Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Because to their superior characteristics of low energy, long range, and large capacity, low energy wide area networking technologies, which are currently embracing a flourishing period with the expansion inside the Internet of things (IoT), can offer a completely new answer for present Smart Grid (SG) connectivity. The services and the gadgets must have rising of services connections that are secure and reliable for the mission-critical SG interactions (QoS). Due to the busy license-free spectrum, this is challenging for unregistered systems to accomplish. As a licensed LPWAN system, Narrowband IoT (NB-IoT) was created based on the LTE services and requirements already in place. As a result, it can offer cellular-level QoS, making it an attractive alternative for SG communication. In this study, we bring NB-IoT to the SG and compared its data rate, latency, and range performance with that of the current represented communication technologies (CT) inside the context of SG communication. The total needs of connections in the SG are thoroughly analyzed from both statistical and subjective aspects, and each is rigorously evaluated for NBIoT. We investigate the SG's typical uses in further detail and assess the viability of NB-IoT in those contexts. Additionally, using Monte Carlo models, the efficiency of NB-IoT in typical SG connectivity situations, such as urban and rural regions, is extensively assessed.

articleTitle: Healthcare Tracking Supervision System Via IoT Detection and Cloud Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Smart and linked health services is one of the many applications made possible by the Internet of Things (IoT).very significant one. Networked monitors, which can be worn on the body or integrated into our homes, enable the collection of detailed data pertaining to our physical and mental health. Such data can result in a favorable transformation change in the healthcare sector when continually gathered, pooled, and skillfully mined. In specific, the data available at unimaginable scales and temporal longitudes combined with a new era of smart processing machine learning can: (a) assist a transformation in the medical profession from the existing post facto make the diagnosis reactive paradigm to an assertive structure for prognosis of illnesses at an initial stages, coupled with preventative measures, cure, and general administration of health rather than illness, (b) enable personalized experience of healthcare, and (c) improve the quality of life for all people In this study, we discuss the advantages and disadvantages of IoT in achieving this future health care goal.

Author Keywords: and remote health monitoring are some related terms

articleTitle: The Effective Role of Cyber Security in Supply Chain to Enhance Supply Chain Performance and Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: It is notoriously harder to identify fraudsters for its fluid nature in terms of recognizable trends. Latest technological breakthroughs were used by scammers. Individuals overcome the protection, incurring millions of dollars of lost revenue. Data mining approaches could be employed to crunch numbers and discover out-of-the-ordinary behaviors, allowing it to be pursued to its cause, in this case a fraudulent payment, activities. In this study, we really would like to evaluate and contrast various popular ml algorithms, namely k-nearest peer (KNN), randomized forest (RF), and support vector (SVM), along with popular deep neural networks, including auto - encoder, Classifiers, Multiple solutions, and multi - layer perceptron (DBN). The European Union (EU), Canada, and Netherlands information will be used. The measures utilized for evaluations are the Region That under Fitted Model (AUC), the Matthew R Squared (MCC), and the cost of failing.

articleTitle: A Detailed Investigation on Various Cyber Security Models and their Comparisons with the Detailed Performance Analysis for the Application of IIOT Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Data security & Cyber security are sometimes used indiscriminately, however the first emphasizes that the exact point does have the potential to be a victim, whereas the second one addresses the function of the individual in the security process. Nevertheless, because it emphasizes the ethical component of civilization holistically, this debate of cyber security holds significant implications. Different architectures & designs have been proposed to handle the problem of cyber security. Additionally, it covers the ideas behind cyber security, including its organizational structure, human resources, and advice on how to safeguard private data on computers. This essay examines such designs, their shortcomings, as well as the prior methods employed to lessen these dangers. Additionally, the paper makes suggestions for additional study.

articleTitle: The Globe Project: Connecting Internet of Things and E-Health
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The necessity to update the way healthcare is now provided is generally acknowledged. Sensing systems(SS) inside the house are of particular relevance because they have been at the centre of numerous investigations in this field. This paper aims to discover a gap in between current state of the art as well as the varied medical needs in environmental assisted living by summarising this fast growing body of research & discussing the ramifications for machine learning (ML) . The fact that numerous approaches concentrate on specific health - related issues usually result in solutions that can't defend intensive data collection & analysis for a more socialized healthcare service. A multi-modality(MM) sensing system(SS) with mixed network access is also described in the report and is being developed by the Sensors It is being developed under SPHERE: The Sensors Network for Health coverage in Residences Surroundings Interdepartmental Research Collaboration (IRC).

articleTitle: The Impact of Electric Conductivity on The Composition of Resin and Hardener in Epoxy Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Adhesive resin compositions with multiple network topologies and maintained pharmacological functions have been created by varying the amount of resin to cementitious material. Heat flux, capacitance spectrometry, DC permeability, and studies of the Ac breaking force were used to describe the produced composites in order to investigate the impact of topology and chemical nature on computational modeling and electrical characteristics. The melting point was shown by the differential scanning calorimetry to be predominantly influenced by the polymer concentration, indicating that side reactions like transesterification reaction or monopolization are minimal within the range of circumstances used here. On the other hand, alterations in framework or kinematics seem to be less likely to cause modifications in Dielectric permittivity with resin redox reactions than modifications in the chemical composition of the material. We especially propose that the residue anionic compound concentrations in the system have a significant impact on the Dielectric permittivity. While there seems to be a general correlation between Dielectric permittivity and DC breakage, studies for AC failure showed that even this characteristic does not change when redox reactions changes, thus implies that the processes governing the Dc complete collapse intensities are distinct.

articleTitle: A Roadmap for AI-Enabled System Design for 5G, 6G, And Beyond Communication: Issues And Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The advancement of communication technologies has led to the development of 5G networks, with 6G and beyond already on the horizon. These advanced networks offer faster data rates and lower latency, which require new system design approaches to fully harness their potential. The integration of artificial intelligence (Al) into system design is crucial for realizing the full potential of these networks. However, the integration of Al brings a new set of challenges and issues that need to be addressed. This research paper presents a roadmap for AI-enabled system design for 5G, 6G, and beyond communication networks. The paper identifies the challenges and issues associated with the integration of Al into communication networks and proposes a systematic approach to overcome them. The proposed roadmap includes four stages: system modeling, data management, Al algorithm selection, and hardware implementation. The paper discusses the challenges and issues associated with each stage and provides possible solutions. The proposed roadmap can guide researchers and practitioners in the development of AI-enabled communication networks, providing a foundation for the design of the next generation of communication systems.

articleTitle: Mitigation Methods of Reducing DDOS Attack Frequency on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A serious risk to genuine organization demands is a distributed denial of service (DDoS) attack. The main DDoS attack was archived in 1996, however, from that point forward, their intricacy and refinement have consistently expanded. A 2 TBps attack on a crucial foundation, including the monetary area, was accounted for in August 2020 during the Coronavirus pandemic. In the accompanying two years, it is anticipated that the number of attacks would twofold, stretching around 15 million. Since its beginning, many relief plans have been made, however, the intricacy is rising, requiring modern arrangements in view of new innovation. A potential and common-sense method for DDoS relief is blockchain. The point of the review is to give an exhaustive examination of the fundamental and intrinsic properties of blockchain, including their decentralization, inside and outer trust lessness, unchanging nature, honesty, obscurity, and evidence, which have demonstrated to be a fantastic contender for battling this destructive cyber threat.

articleTitle: The Impact of the Metaverse on Organizational Culture and Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A new idea called the "metaverse" depicts a virtual environment where users may interact, communicate, and do business in a completely immersive setting. Organizational culture and communication are anticipated to be significantly impacted as the metaverse develops and becomes more extensively used. The goal of this study is to examine how the metaverse affects corporate culture and communication by examining the existing research on the subject and carrying out novel research. According to the literature study, the metaverse has the potential to alter how companies’ function by fostering more social engagement, cooperation, and communication as well as opening up new possibilities for distant work and virtual events. These results were backed by the findings of the original study, which also demonstrated that the metaverse had a beneficial effect on company culture and communication. The findings imply that in order to take advantage of the potential presented by the metaverse, companies need actively be ready for the changes it will bring about.

articleTitle: Study on the NB-IoT Based Smart Medical System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In latest days, with the continuous advancement and development of World wide web, IoT, as well as smart gateway technology, such technological advances have been utilized more frequently in everyday family life, including academic learning, agro - industries, manufacturing output, healthcare, as well as many other sectors, to start making people's job & lives easier and more straightforward. The roles of permanent data point, such as conventional nursing terminals & physician platforms, no longer satisfy persons expanding healthcare needs, particularly in the setting of healthcare knowledge generation as well as health problems. Therefore, it is now of the utmost need to figure out how to incorporate such emerging techniques into a cost-effective & smart healthcare information system which realizes the comfortable administration & effective administration of healthcare professionals. In light of the challenges the clinic is now facing, this article designs a intelligent hospital system for managing information & suggests a smart healthcare strategy focused on NBIoT platform. According to testing results, customers can quickly & simply register for meetings using the Smart phone application. Health personnel could more easily finish their duties by examining patient information & facility latest news. A much more effective load distribution can be achieved using an adaptable balancing algorithm, as shown by comparing findings of efficiency difference between the ordinary servers with adaptable computation web host. Therefore, the web-based system for managing health information can administer institutions more thoroughly.

articleTitle: Domestic Security Clustering Algorithm Based on AP's Capability to Discriminate Location: A survey
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Due to its excellent localization precision, worldwide application, and lack of supplementary equipment, a WIFI-based indoor localization method has garnered considerable interest. However, as the interior environment varies dynamically, the environment influences access point (AP) connectivity in various locations to varying degrees. The conventional algorithm for fingerprint localisation cannot account for irregular received signal strength indication (RSSI) in diverse places. This work presents an algorithm for localisation of interior protection depending on the capability of position discriminating access points (SLABLDA), which is resilient in complicated, abrupt interior settings. The AP location diversity models for aptitude assessment is supplied during the offline detection phase of the process in order to identify the prejudice based on locality capacity of AP in a variety of indoor complicated situations. During the online part of the process, a strategy for adjusting the gap between fingerprints using the lowest variation in RSSI is described in order to limit the The atmosphere's temporal dynamics are causing RSSI disturbance. Tests were done have shown that the technique that was proposed is capable of successfully filtering the effects of anomalous RSSI in complex and abrupt interior environments, which results in an increase in the localization accuracy in comparison to the algorithm that is currently used for fingerprint localization.

articleTitle: Quantifying Performance of Human using AI : A Data-Driven Exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: People's employability, skill, and drive may provide a long-term competitive advantage since these factors are difficult to replicate by rivals. Human engagement, and especially that of employees, has been singled out as a critical management strategy for creating this competitive edge. The fields of industrial relations and human resource management, however, have historically taken opposing stances on the importance of employees' input.The former has been steered by economic insights, while the latter is founded on employee reactions to choices made at work. Three of the most well-known ways to get workers invested in their company are via managerial or decision-making responsibilities, financial incentives, and stock holdings. 50 businesses in the NCR Reigon, India, were surveyed to see how three participation strategies affected employee happiness, productivity, and company success. 500 answers were collected from staff members regarding their involvement habits and general happiness, providing objective data for use in evaluating the organization's success. The findings demonstrated a substantial association between any type of engagement and employee well-being, even after adjusting for firm size and industry. Participation in making decisions by workers was shown to have a negative correlation with productivity on the job. Financial involvement procedures did not seem to have any correlation with the efficiency of the organisation, according to the statistical research. This study lends credence to the idea that one of the pillars of HR practises has a positive impact on employee well-being, but it does not provide conclusive evidence that employee involvement directly corresponds to better business results.Scientists and academic contributors get access to new areas of inquiry, while business leaders gain valuable insights.

articleTitle: Product Aspect Ranking Framework Based Feature Selection Using Sentimental Classification Algorithm For Consumer Feedbacks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A product-based aspect ranking methodology to find essential product features from consumer feedback. The consumer has been using these websites and frequently adds their comments and feedback that will be useful for other users for product evaluation. In existing system refers to only partial comments based on the opinion and consumers simultaneously exploiting the aspect frequencies using the probabilistic aspect ranking algorithm. However, it is impractical for consumers to manually pick the main characteristics of items from among the numerous reviews that are available. The proposed system uses Sentimental Analysis along with SentiwordNet methods. The data was collected from various websites and extracted the user's comments or opinions of good comments, bad comments, or unbiassed commentaries and marked in the manuscript. Feature founded product removal is one of the important levels of sentimental classification algorithms that will explain the feature of the assumed commentaries and categorize the comments for individually feature of the product. The proposed system of SentiWordNet Scores used as Features found 69.4% accuracy compared to SentiwordNet term counting. The aspect-based sentimental classification algorithm is proposed with 67% accuracy to classify the optimal comments, pessimistic comments, and impartial comments for each product feature.

articleTitle: A Novel Economical System for Crucial Cardiac Rate Task Scheduler in Fog Cloud Architecture Using the IoMT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Recently, a cloud centered Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) service has appeared that provides various health care to client wearing transducer devices. These facilities are available everywhere and may be used at any time. Particularly, continual cloud facilities are needed for electrocardiogram (ECG) transducer like Lead I & Lead II to operate in live time. These offerings must be more cost-effective for the customers because they are paid for. Crucial cardiac cost-efficient job scheduling issues for smart healthcare in the edge cloud system were taken into consideration in this work. The goal was to provide the created information with cost-effective, ubiquitous cloud services. For the objective of decreasing overall costs, this work presented a health care-based fog cloud system (HCBFS) to gather, evaluate, & decide the procedure of crucial activities of the cardiac clinical uses. The health care awareness cost-efficient task scheduling (HCCETS) algorithm framework, proposed in this study, not just to schedules all jobs with the economical possible but also ensures that they are completed by their deadline. The suggested work scheduler algorithm architecture outscored the current algorithm techniques in terms of effectiveness, according to performance assessment.

articleTitle: Method for Recognizing Hand Gestures in Real- Time Across Multiple Sensors Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The field of human-computer interaction includes multimodal gesture detection as a key task. In human-machine interface, wearable sensors for hand gestures consume additional potential than ambient detection due to their short price, weightiness, and wide applicability. Despite the fact that research on hand motions with wearable sensors already exists, the results are rarely transferable from one scenario to another. And when it comes to collaboration between humans and technology, there is still no agreed-upon protocol for hand signals. In this study, we introduce a new technique of using hand gestures to command the environment. An affordable Internet of Things (IoT) sensor-pluggable device that has an integrated accelerometer and gyroscope is used to collect the data for analysis. Inputs to the feature extractor network include the raw data from the RGB sense modality, the visual flow sense modality, and the disassembled information from the hands. This work provides an additional modality, feature extraction based on temporal differences in RGB sense modality. The characteristics of these modes are learned using a pre-trained version of the Googlenet Caffe model. All of these components need to come together as a whole for the fusion procedure to be successful. When doing a classification, the bidirectional LSTM network is used. The new approach is put through its paces using the IPN Hand dataset. When first starting out, each modality is employed independently. Then, we employ such mixtures to boost classification precision even further. Combining the segmented indicator sense modality with the optical movement mode and the chronological transformation of the RGB sense modality yielded the greatest results. The suggested method for multimodal gesture recognition outperforms the benchmark methods, as shown by the simulation results

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Statistical Approaches for Data Classification in SCM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The researchers in this study analyzed the Supply Chain Management (SCM) strategies of 25 different businesses in India. These businesses ranged from retail chains and logistics providers to FMCG manufacturers and hotels to power plants and automotive manufacturers and their suppliers. The research was undertaken in 2005 via on-site visits, in-depth interviews with both middle and upper-level managers, and secondary data collection. Logistics, transportation, forming strategic alliances, and information and communication technology (ICT) were all areas of concentration. The investigation revealed both commonalities and distinctions in SCM practices among the sampled businesses, as well as new developments and potential trouble spots. In addition, suggestions were made for further investigation.

articleTitle: Technical use of Smart Contracts in Blockchain-Based Project Management
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Smart contracts have emerged as a key element in blockchain technology, offering a new paradigm for managing projects and executing transactions in a decentralized manner. This article explores the role of smart contracts in blockchain-based project management, highlighting their potential to streamline processes, reduce costs, and increase transparency and trust among stakeholders. The article analyzes the benefits and limitations of using smart contracts in project management and provides insights into the various use cases and applications of smart contracts, such as decentralized autonomous organizations, supply chain management, and project funding. Additionally, the article discusses the challenges and risks associated with smart contracts, including security, scalability, and regulatory compliance. Overall, this article provides a comprehensive overview of the role of smart contracts in blockchain-based project management and its implications for the future of the industry.

articleTitle: Detection of Schizophrenia using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Schizophrenia is a mental illness that impacts approximately 1% of the global population. The condition can make it challenging for individuals with schizophrenia to differentiate between internally generated and externally generated stimuli due to abnormalities in the corollary discharge process of the nervous system. This phenomenon provides an explanation for certain symptoms associated with schizophrenia. Exploring this process and its connection to the disease's symptoms can contribute to our understanding of the abnormal brain processes observed in affected individuals. Advancements in the study of electrophysiological brain activity, along with improved access to EEG data, offer new possibilities for investigating and diagnosing neuronal disorders in real-world settings. In this study, a larger dataset of EEG data was utilized, including data from previous research published in Schizophrenia Bulletin Advance Access on July 10, 2013. The dataset combined EEG records from 22 healthy individuals and 36 individuals with schizophrenia, as well as additional data from 10 healthy individuals and 13 schizophrenia patients from a prior study. The classification phase involved considering two different methods for diagnosing schizophrenia using EEG signals. Traditional machine learning techniques, such as xgboost, decision trees, naïve Bayes, random forest, Long short-term memories (LSTMs), support vector machines, two-dimensional convolutional networks (2D-CNNs), and two-dimensional convolutional networks-LSTMs, were employed to classify the EEG signals. Deep learning models were also implemented, and various activation functions were compared. Among the proposed deep learning models, the SVM architecture demonstrated the highest performance level. The SVM model utilized the RBF Kernel with cross-validation values (CV) of 3, 6, and 8. Remarkably, the SVM model achieved a precision rate of 100 percent.

articleTitle: Implementation of Soft Computing Techniques in Fine-Tuning of TRM-Concrete Bond Strength Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The bond strength in between reinforcing steel bars and the concrete is a critical factors lies in the structural integrity of reinforced structures of concrete. Some approaches have been proposed to foresee the strength of bond, but these models may not accurately represent the complex nature of the bond phenomenon, leading to inaccurate predictions. This study aims to improve the accuracy of existing TRM-concrete bond strength models by fine-tuning them using soft computing techniques. The results of this study demonstrate that fine-tuning existing TRM-concrete bond strength models using soft computing techniques significantly improves their accuracy in predicting bond strength. The fine-tuned models also outperform the original models, indicating that the soft computing techniques used in this study are effective in improving the accuracy of existing TRM-concrete bond strength models. This study contributes to the development of accurate TRM-concrete bond strength prediction models that can be used in the design of reinforced concrete structures. The fine-tuning process using soft computing techniques can also be applied to other existing models to improve their accuracy in predicting complex phenomena.

articleTitle: Industry 4.0 Networks' Federated Blockchain Learning Framework For Cognitive Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cognitive computing is a ground-breaking notion in AI which replicates the thought pattern of the human mind. As a result, Industry 4.0 robotics is slowly flourishing owing to cognitive computing. The development of a variety of Machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques has already made it possible to see the beginning of the march toward improved decision-making and data-driven intelligent manufacturing. However, there are a number of additional issues that need to be addressed, such as issues with performance, limitations of data resources, and attacks including poisoning. Recent research efforts have just scratched the surface of the problem, which often leads to erratic performance, inefficiency, and the disclosure of private information. We built a decentralized paradigm for massive data-driven cognitive computing (D2C) in this research by mixing blockchain technology with federated learning. D2C stands for data-driven cognitive computing. The problem of a "data island" may be solved by federated learning if privacy is protected and efficient processing is carried out, while blockchain technology gives incentives in the form of a potent anti-poisoning system in a truly decentralized method. Convergence may be sped up with the use of blockchain technology enabled federated learning by taking advantage of better verifications and member choices. The results of a comprehensive review and assessment demonstrate that D2C is more effective than the designs and models that are now the industry standard.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis of An Induction Motors Using AI and ML: An Efficient Way
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The industry is becoming more and more focused on boosting the energy efficiency and lowering the operating expenses of induction motors. Frequent surveillance of the machine's status using monitoring systems that can discover breakdowns at an early stage may greatly minimize these expenses and enhance the motor's efficiency. Expensive shutdowns, unexpected downtime, breakdowns, and workplace accidents may be avoided by early defect identification. Motor losses and service life may be minimized by preventing and treating early signs of failure. Numerous review articles provide in-depth looks at certain defect detection methods for induction motors. All the methods discussed here can, however, only spot problems in their more advanced forms. We were unable to find any review that compares different methods for finding problems in their early phases of development. In this study, we examine existing methods and tools for early defect detection. The armature, rotor, and rolling bearings of a motor are the primary targets of this examination of current approaches. Methodologies are described, and suggestions for further study in this field are offered, for both steady-state and transient motor operation conditions.

articleTitle: Assessment of Different Deep Learning Models for Hardware Requirements and Pre-Processing Steps for Efficient Wind Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Wind power generating systems are increasing their presence in the whole energy fabric. However, intermittent energy production by wind power plants due to its environmental dependency poses a threat to the energy grid. To address this challenge of uncertainty, auxiliary energy storage units or accurate and reliable forecasting are two potential solutions. However, integration of energy storage units will increase the capital investment and in turn, will decrease the return on investment of wind power plants. So, an accurate forecasting mechanism is the most promising way to address the challenges of uncertainty. In recent years, lots of research works have proposed different Machine Learning (ML) or Deep Learning (DL) approaches for accurate wind power forecasting. In this proposed work different DL models are analyzed for wind power forecasting with different pre-processing methods. So, the major contribution of the work lies in the finding an optimal deep-learning model and pre-processing strategy for improving wind power prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Development of a sleep monitoring system using cloud computing and big data techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Among the most significant sleep concerns is obstructive apnea syndrome in sleep (OASS) which harms the quality of life. A few effects of OASS include cognitive decline, impaired psychiatric function, behavior problems, and personality ailments. Real-time monitoring of this condition is thus essential for clinical services. There seem to be numerous OASS-detecting techniques. Hence, the present experiment provides a new system both for detecting and assisting therapies of OASS in elderly individuals. This design was developed for tracking a variety of variables including the surroundings where a person goes to sleep, their sleeping quality, physical activity levels, and physiological variables by utilizing open data from smarter city systems. 2 sorts of processing are performed by the suggested method. In the instance of a crisis, real-time notices can be sent to those in charge of caring for the old aged owing to the rule-relied pre-processing technique. This method fundamentally relies on a fog computing strategy applied in a smarter device functioning at networking edges which also provides enhanced interoperable ability services, including technological, semantic, and syntactic capabilities. Big data devices on cloud computing are utilized in this process. The effectiveness of the system has also been assessed given latencies. The outcomes obtained indisputably show that pre-processing of data at networking edges increases system effectiveness.

articleTitle: Investigating Low & High Transfers Training for Multi-task Face Identification Using a Semi-supervised Neuronal Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Recently years have seen a significant increase in research on visual identification issues including identification, aging, sexuality, & expression identification. This same classification of the majority of non-verbal Living beings Interactions scenarios became dependent on their implementation in robotics systems. Deep convolutional neuronal systems have demonstrated to be efficient in this respect when analyzing various face expressions, but at a heavy price: they need a sizable quantity of task-specific labelled information to attain maximal generalisation. A uniform semi-supervised deep network system is suggested in this research to deal with this issue. Our combination model consists of a set of permutation networks that fine-tunes the high-level faces notions for the identification of individuality, time of life team, sex, & facial expressions, as well as an unsupervised deep generative confrontational connection that gets to know basic character traits of face depictions.or the way you look. To avoid the need for a significant quantity of highly labelled learning information, our system uses continuous laterally interconnections among the convolutional streams so that it can exchange the high-abstraction specifics of all of such jobs. We suggest a number of tests to assess each component of our hybrids system, particularly the influence of the progressing interconnections on acquiring the individual image identification problems, & we find that our framework outperforms task-specific systems.

articleTitle: A New Method of Optical Spectrum Analysis for Advanced Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Prospective 5th (5G) telecommunication has very good expectations for service quality in areas include bandwidth utilization, congestion, power efficiency, and number of nodes. More significantly, IoT is needed for extensive network infrastructure. Short wavelength transmission, light authenticity, optical image transmission, and free storage photonic are all examples of coherent optical communication (OWC) technologies that may be beneficial in easing the widespread adoption of 5G and the Internet of Things. Applications of OWC connections to 5G and IoT solutions are explained in detail in this article. High - speed wireless services like videoconference, mobile devices, greater Internet access, etc. need relatively high upcoming wireless modern communications. Current signal repeaters only handle a measly few thousand megabits per second (Mbps) of data transmission. Recently, large implementations in semiconductor devices lighting technology have fueled renewed interest in optical wired (OW), a potential complimentary solution for RF technology. The objective of this study was to analyze and synthesize key generation in OW communication, with just a focus on the merits that optical wireless systems would provide to the future era of wireless networks.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method for Personal Health Records That May Be Used in Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Personal health records (PHR) are a major study area in the present day. Numerous research studies have put out a number of management and organization strategies for PHRs. The function of a PHR in emergency situations is one of many unresolved concerns, though. In this work, a method for managing PHR information in emergencies is suggested.
