A PHR is managed by its owner; therefore, managing a PHR in an emergency depends critically on how emergency personnel may even if any PHR proprietor is unavailable to give permission, view PHR information. Each PHR may be divided into a number of categories using the suggested system. A separate constraint is presented by each group. The emergency personnel can also enter each category in accordance with the guidelines established by in this work, the threshold cryptosystem is modified to let a chosen group whereas the PHR owners is sleeping, of PHR-owner-delegates to authorize the urgent personnel.

articleTitle: Encoder-Decoder Model For Detecting Spammed Tweets on Twitter
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Accompanied by the desire for communal engagement expanding in nowadays high society, a well-known social media website called Twitter plays a vital role in enabling every citizen to communicate socially, whether by tweeting a tweet on someone else’s behalf or researching many subjects in the running world. But these days, some spammers have infected this platform, connecting their URLs to informative tweets to drive traffic to their spam websites even in spite of no connection between the material in the URL and the tweet message. In this paper with the help of encoder-decoder methodology combined with a vectorizer converter on the stated threads and their connected URLs, this study offers a novel method to determine if a tweet written by the other person is spam or ham, which results in the finding of a similarized vectors between them.

articleTitle: Publicly Verifiable Attribute-Based Encryption and Distributed Decryption
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A useful crypto method for access control and precise delivery of encrypted information is attribute-based encryption (ABE). A fundamental issue with ABE, meanwhile, is because the analytical expense rises exponentially with the intricacy of the access structure. Exporting of computation in a secure manner is a potential solution to the problem. T hedecompiler may contract out the bulk of the decoding costs while still protecting the privacy of the information. Current ABE with contracted decryption cannot provide public authenticity or outsource the deciphering of preexisting ABE decryption. For every ABE scheme, we must create a special outsourced decryption in order to address the first flaw. The second prevents the use of ABE (with external decryption) in a hostile environment. We provide a broad strategy for changing any ABE.To overcome the aforementioned two concerns, we provide a universal method for converting any ABE strategy (premised on pairs) as just an ABE strategy publically verified contracted decryption. Under the suppositions because the fundamental economic ABE system is safe as well as other person performing the contracted Unlocking is analytical, our method is secure.

articleTitle: A New Design for Protecting Cyber-Attacks and Harmful Threats in IoT Communication Network with Efficient Deep Learning-Based Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Fast progress in both smart devices with limited resources and state-of-the-art communication methods have helped establish the Internet of Things (IoT) as the gold standard for low-power lossy networks. However, because to the low computing, storage, and networking capabilities of the endpoint devices, these networks are susceptible to cyber assaults. IoT network security solutions are often rendered ineffective since many attacks are produced by slightly modifying previously known assaults. With their superior performance, deep learning algorithms have seen rapid adoption in security applications in recent years. In this paper, we introduce the IoT-IDCS-CNN, a brand new, unsupervised deep learning-based method for detecting and categorising cyberattacks in IoT communication networks. The system uses high-performance computing on dependable Nvidia GPUs, and parallel processing on fast Intel CPUs. It is structured into three parts: a traffic classification module, a feature learning module, and a refinement module for engineering features. Each part is developed independently and then tested and combined to create the complete system.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle: An Efficient way of Signal Rage Finding Using Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: One important aspect of electric cars is distance. The popularity of electric mobility depends on enhancing the range of hybrid cars. The primary factor determining an electric car length is its high capacity. It is appropriate to concentrate on other characteristics like as lightness, aero drag rate, or the correct size of the engine since battery is the most costly component of an electric engine. The driver's effect on endurance is just as essential as design considerations like storage capacity. In order to understand how such variables vary, simulators been made. Actual driving circuits were utilized to improve realism.

Author Keywords: CURTIS and Real Time Driving Analysis

articleTitle: Threat Evaluation of Enterprise Utilizations via Graphical Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Studying cyber resilience has proved to be a difficult technological obstacle. Numerous case studies have been performed to assess the cyber resilience of enterprise business systems using attack graphs. removing the assets level, service resource, activity surface for the commercial processes, etc.. from a generic business enterprise system is challenging for automation since here is where task dependencies and formal vulnerability description meet to build attack graphs. We provide a model for threat analysis of a company based on a specified group of vulnerabilities spread across many layers of business operations. First, we collect the company's task dependencies from its process flow (BPMN), and afterwards we retrieve the hierarchy dependencies that includes the asset-, service-, and process management components. We infer a logical concept of security risk transmission from the graphical reliance structure and the susceptibility criteria in order to build MulVAL multi-step, multi-stage attacks. The MulVAL-created attack graph is imported into the graph database Neo4J to provide online/real-time dynamic security risk dissemination analysis. In addition, we detail how the system's risk analysis may be achieved with the inclusion of certain parameters. Since we took an all-encompassing approach, threat analysis is now flexible and extensible. We show how our approach can be applied to larger systems and how graphical modeling can be used to investigate risk evaluations for enterprise software. In turn, this enables the use of a wide range of mitigation techniques for reducing the spread of threats and vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Managing Techniques, Strategy, Validation, and Dataset for Harmful Threats Detection in IoT Networks: A Critical Review
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is fast growing to have a bigger influence on everything from ordinary living to massive commercial systems. Tragically, it's caught hackers' notice, who have turned the Internet of Things into an opportunity for unlawful activity, perhaps paving the way for an assault on end nodes. Numerous IoT intrusion detection systems (IDS) are currently developed to achieve this aim, with thorough classification of recognition methodologies, evaluation procedures, and distribution tactics. This review paper offers a thorough assessment of contemporary IoT IDS, a summary of the process, the implementation strategy, the testing method, and data sets that frequently get employed for IDS innovation. Malware, internet of things, fault diagnosis, intrusion detection system, deep learning, internet of things, assaults, and IoT security are some of the terms used in this article.

articleTitle: A Conjunctional Approach for Enhanced and Extended Security in Big data Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Today people’s live in the "Era of Data". The data has been tortured and indulged in confession in many ways. The term big data deals with large volumes of data that streams in a fraction of a second and of-course in the format of unstructured data. As the data are big the challenges are high and the process of handling data is becoming so daunting. And the security issues of big data are becoming a great threat to the data which is very critical for the development of many organizations. As the security solution cannot be given as a one-stop solution a layered methodology has been proposed in this work for securing confidential data. It is a combination of heavy encryption traditional algorithm RSA and data masking technique which will lead to better security for the data. The reason why the RSA algorithm is proposed is that by using this algorithm it is very safe to exchange data over the internet, it maintains the confidentiality of the data to a high extent and this algorithm will maintain high toughness because breaking the keys through interceptors is difficult. The results and discussions of our proposed methodology will lead to an enhanced security system with fuzzy procedures which efficiently strengthen the system.

articleTitle: Project Management and Evaluation system Using Node JS
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Project Management is a social hub for students to interact and showcase their projects in a dynamic environment where other students and faculty can also put their thoughts. Major Project is the essential part of student’s graduation, where they need to apply all the learning and build something innovative and inspiring. Students don’t understand that what other students are developing because of no interaction. Thus with the help of this application, it is tried to solve this problem. An application is proposed to address about how student can go through an application to identify their capabilities and get an idea to develop a project accordingly. Students will be able to address a problem and find a solution to it, although through its inception organizing major projects can be a hassle therefore It is aptly called "Project Management" as students can join in a league with like-minded students for their major projects. Depending on factors like area of interest, the number of milestones covered and the grade received, the live popularity project tracking system provides a highly-standardized, automated technique for ranking. Top 10 projects are displayed on the homepage based on these rankings.There are two key features in PMi)User Interactionii)Project Progress Tracking.

articleTitle: Problems in IoT Networks: Usage, Infrastructure, And Engineering of Industrial IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The term "Things (Iot," sometimes known as "World wide web of Almost everything," refers to a network of physical items that have circuitry that allows interaction over wireless networks or wired networks (such as the World wide web) for a variety of functions, such as gps tracking or control. The availability of a web app via which a user may connect the home's technology helps to improve productivity and save costs. The use of linked IoT settings will help not just businesses, but also towns, hospitals, industries, and state agencies. These settings are defined by the transfer of data across tools, gadgets, and people as well as these tools and gadgets. This study examines the advantages of Iot applications used in businesses from several angles. In order to make references to actual events and circumstances, we use a specific example. This article's other goal is to provide a model of architectural for the platforms and investigate how they work by examining the technology used to create them or the security risks that may be solved.

articleTitle: Future Field Systems using Graph Database and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: IoT, or the network of things, has created a technical foundation for intentional connectedness. IoT enables smart objects and sensors to perceive, link, and even remotely control objects. The Network of Things has seen tremendous progress, and the use of these technologies is very scalable. Every area of computing is expected to be affected by the Internet of Things (IoT), which is growing quickly. Smart homes, smart roads, and green infrastructure are already becoming a reality. These advances also have an impact on a country's military industry. The main component of the aerospace industry's response is the deployment of sensors. The main goal of visual inputs is to draw conclusions about the information that will be useful for tactical analysis and decision-making in the future fighting environment. Every piece of information, including the key health indicators of the soldiers as well as their weapons, ammo, and location status, has a specific significance and is crucial to the battlefield director seated in the main base. In order to improve the decision support system and provide troops with an insight of every aspect of their performance on the battlefield, we are putting forward a unique method to link the World of Things with a growing graph database. In order to query the data structure for target acquisition patterns and gain a tactical edge over its competitors, we propose a hypothetical use context of the current battlefield.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Wastewater Treatment Process
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Wastewater treatment plants play a vital role in supplying a stable source of water due to the fast population increase and increasing demand for clean and reliable water. Being able to dispose of or reuse wastewater safely is the main objective of wastewater treatment. However, before the wastewater is treated, the options for disposal or reuse must be examined so that the proper treatment technique may be applied. The water treatment system is made up of six subsystems that are connected in a series. The rates of failure and repair are considered to be exponentially distributed. The differential equations were developed using a probabilistic technique, and Markov; the birth-death approach, was used to create the mathematical model. These are then solved by the Runge-Kutta method. The findings could be useful to plant designers and those in charge of maintaining treated water quality.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Performance Indicators To Improve The Quality in Indian Educational Institutions Using GRD Ensemble Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The Indian government uses a mechanism called the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) to rate those institutions of higher education. The NIRF uses five metrics, including research and development, teaching and learning-resources, graduation-outcome, outreach and inclusivity, and perception, to rank institutions. However, there is ongoing debate about the comparability and accuracy of the NIRF metrics. This study aims to compare the NIRF metrics used for ranking higher education institutions in India. In this study, GRD stands for machine learning algorithms including Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, and Decision Tree are used together with a mixed-methods strategy that combines qualitative and quantitative research techniques. The findings of the study suggest that while the NIRF metrics have some strengths and limitations, they provide a valuable tool for ranking higher education institutions in India. The study’s results will be useful for stakeholders in the education sector, including policy makers, higher education institutions, and stakeholders, gain a better understanding of the NIRF measures and their applicability for ranking higher education institutions in India. Finding the key performance indicators (KPIs) that can be used to assess and improve the calibre of instruction in Indian educational institutions. The study also emphasises the necessity of continuing data gathering and analysis to maintain the usefulness and efficacy of these KPIs. In the conclusion, this study delivers insightful information about how data analysis contributes to raising educational standards in India and offers actionable advice for institutions wishing to improve.

articleTitle: Influence of hybrid combination of big data and cyber physical system in case of ind 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Big data and hyperphysical systems have a lot of promising applications in Industry 4.0 for achieving personalization and increasing continuous improvement. There have only been a few extant assessments whether on electronic systems or big data in Smart factories since it is a relatively new idea that emerged from a smart factories vision endorsed by the German government in 2011. Additionally, there are a lot fewer studies that focus on the interaction with big data and computer crimes technologies in Manufacturing 4.0. But big data and cybersecurity perturbation theory have many similarities. For instance, computer crimes organizations will continually produce a vast volume of data that has to be processed using big data approaches to increase levels and high, privacy, and effectiveness. Therefore, we are conducting this poll to indicate potential research path for achieving complete freedom in Ir4.0 and to draw better attention to this important junction.

articleTitle: Ethereum Decentralized peer-to-peer Contracts Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With its dedicated money Ether, Ethereum offers regionalized Ethernet simulated computers to manage as an open-source public blockchain, peer-to-peer agreementsability to perform clever contracts. And since Ethereum is the second largest blockchain, transaction data volumes are growing rapidly. However, at this point, most analyses of Ethereum data are focused on the statistical characteristics of Ethereum nodes and do not examine how transactions between them behave. In this research, leverage transaction data from existing blocks to categorize users and smart contracts into groups and Applies machine learning to Ethereum analytics for the first time. The identification data of the accessible Ethereum users and smart contracts is used to examine the clustering findings.

articleTitle: Internet of Multimedia Things an Open Source P2P Publish/Subscribe Framework for Massive Semantic Content Spaces
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The use of distributed hash tables to create a framework for peer-to-peer networks (DHTs) are well-suited to facilitating communication and collaboration between autonomous entities that are both dynamic and geographically scattered due to their decentralized and highly scalable character. Since the advent of interactive software and services in the IoT, the communication traffic generated by sensing devices has undergone a drastic transformation, moving away from structured textual and numerical data and towards unstructured and massive virtual tours. Since it may be utilized to extract such a wide variety of human-recognizable concepts, the semantic content space of digital information like video and audio is exceedingly large. Semantic distance between data consumers and producers is created by vast the sheer size of the share this will ensure necessitates the use of community publish/subscribe systems. Neither any DHT would ever achieve that exact-match query method to work when users are trying to specify the same semantic notions using different terms. In this paper, we introduce OpenPubSub, an approximative semantic publish/subscribe system based on peer-to-peer content distribution. In this research, we present an original event routing model that integrates hierarchical peer-to-peer rendezvous routing with gossiping. This network, in contrast to those created on card access control spaces, is based on a vector space for meaning with many dimensions. Methods for roughly conducting semantic lookup operations, splitting the world in two, creating a semantic DHT via bootstrapping, and categorizing nodes according to their shared properties are provided. Using the findings, we discover that the hybrid routing strategy can achieve up to 42.3% recall while reducing the messaging cost by 56%, and that at an expected upper constraint on recall for event matching of 54.4%, Using a shuttle routing strategy can improve recall by up to 52.0% while reducing transmission latency by 41%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cooperative Communications with Harvesting Wireless Power
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In this article, one central connecting, one source, and one repeater make up a wirelessly-powered joint network system. The originator and intermediary in the under-consideration intranet lack an integrated electricity grid, in opposition to typical crns. For the purpose of their joint information transfer, they must depend on the power generation gathered from the messages transmitted by the. We suggest a harvest-then-collaborate approach that relies on these three different frameworks, where the resource and relay gather energy from within the [1] broadcast and combine in the uplink for the source’s data exchange. The estimated sealed formula for the suggested method’s rate over channels using Rayleigh fading is obtained while taking into account a wait time transmitting power. This study is then expanded to include the case of multiple relays, from which the estimated output of the system using two widely used relay methods is determined. Additionally given are the exponential evaluations for the examined algorithms' transmission efficiency at high signal-to-noise radio levels. Numerical models are used to verify all theory findings. The effects of system factors on output efficiency, such as time allotment, relay frequency, and relay orientation, are thoroughly examined.

articleTitle: GPS and GSM-based Internet of Things based cable fault location detector
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: To forestall over the top possibly destructive block, electrical lines frequently used to convey the energy are for the most part situated under the ground in metropolitan regions. Accordingly, diagnosing the specific site of any issues that arise turns out to be unquestionably difficult. A breakdown may at times happen for various driving variables like exhuming, cataclysmic events, and building, etc. On account of the line's unsure area, the maintenance system is intricate. This created system is expected to distinguish disappointments in underground organizations here Ohm's regulation is being utilized to exactly confine a base station to a distance of km utilizing an Arduino microcontroller gear. A blend of resistors addresses the link which detects the ongoing in the circuit and it is associated with Arduino microcontroller of this framework. Switch sets are responsible for setting up the shortcoming, and LCDs are connected to microcontrollers that display data; the switch sets are responsible for setting up the issue, and LCDs are connected to microcontrollers that display data; if a mistake occurs, GPS tracks will show on the LCD where the issuing district is located. It utilizes GSM to make an impression on the enrolled contact subtleties telling them of the link's area.

Author Keywords: GPS and GSM based Fault Detection System

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Predicting Customers' Lifetime Value: A Systematic Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: With so many successful online merchants in the e-business market in the online era taking heed to customer relationship management (CRM) has become a prerequisite for maintaining competitive advantage. Single customer categories that can be measured in Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) which is defined as the quantity of earnings from a customer in a business during their lifetime, is required to develop an effective CRM strategy. CLV modelling using four most popular Machine Learning(ML) algorithms namely linear regression, decision tree, support vector machine and random forest algorithm are used to find the expected business estimate of a client. The IBM Watson Dataset was used as a training set to evaluate and compare the performance of the four ML regressors in terms of key parameters such as RMSE and R Squared. The findings in this research offer a summary of cutting edge ML methods for CLV prediction.

articleTitle: The way to implement Cryptocurrency for International Payments and Remittances
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The use of cryptocurrency for international payments and remittances has been a topic of increasing interest in recent years. Cryptocurrencies, such as Bitcoin and Ethereum, have the potential to reduce transaction costs, increase transaction speed and provide financial inclusion for individuals and businesses that are currently unbanked or underbanked. The research aims to explore the current use cases of cryptocurrency for international payments and remittances, as well as the challenges and opportunities that arise from their adoption. The research will also investigate the regulatory landscape and its impact on the adoption of cryptocurrency for international payments and remittances. The research will be conducted through a combination of literature review and case studies of existing cryptocurrency payment and remittance services. The findings of this research will provide insights into the potential of cryptocurrency as a viable alternative to traditional payment and remittance methods and inform the development of policy and regulation in this area.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Privacy Preservation with Minimal Information Leakage
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A wide range of application sectors are progressively using machine learning (ML). A successful machine learning (ML) model often requires a lot of training data and powerful processing resources, especially the newly developing deep neural network model. Due to the possibility of information leakage and the changing legislative landscapes that progressively limit Privacy-sensitive data access and use, the need for large amounts of available data, raises significant privacy concerns. Additionally, adversarial techniques. Therefore, carefully thought-out privacy-preserving machine learning (PPML) solutions are essential and are generating more and more research attention from academia and business. More and more PPML initiatives are being put forth through the incorporation of privacy-preserving methods into machine learning algorithms. As existing PPML techniques intersect with ML, systems, security, and privacy, among others, there is an important requirement to understand current research, associated barriers, and roadmaps for future research. This study offers a PGU model to help evaluate various PPML solutions by intricately breaking down each solution's privacy-preserving functions. It also evaluates and summarizes existing privacy-preserving methodologies in a methodical manner. Phase, Guarantee, and Technical Utility make up the PGU model's trinity. We also address the special features and difficulties of PPML and suggest future study avenues that will be beneficial to a wide variety of research communities in the fields of Machine learning, security systems, distributed systems and privacy system.

articleTitle: Blockchain Usages In Hospitality Management
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The bulk of digital payments in the era of Industry 4.0 are done through programmes that are supported by gateways of different payments. The issues mentioned above can be resolved by using a decentralised approach like Block-Chain, which enables trust and reputation management across many stakeholders including banks, travel agencies, airports, railroads, cruise ships, hotels, restaurants, and local taxis. In response to the aforementioned discussion, a framework called BeSHMT (Block-Chain Enabled Smart Hospitality Management and Tourism) has been proposed. It enables visitors to interact with key parties through a mono-wallet identification number associated with a Crypto-Currency server to undertake payments. BeSHMT employs an immutable ledger so that travelers can travel without having to worry about producing proofs. The BeSHMT framework also includes a deep-learning enabled by tourism (DLeT) framework that is taught using data from past visitors. It offers potential tourists’ ratings for the sites that have recently been visited by other travelers. Finally, we show through case studies that BeSHMT outperforms conventional frameworks in the tourism sector in terms of Return on Investment (ROI).

abstract: As part of the verification procedure, credentials are typically hashed. If the original password is simple and obvious, attackers may recover it from the hash. Many cyber attacks have occurred as a consequence, often targeting specific cipher-text methods. In this research, we provide a more secure system for handling image-based passwords through cryptographic techniques (VC). Our approach takes a login name from a work of literature and transforms it into two VC-protected pictures, in addition to the standard hashes and words. Using SEED and certain hidden knowledge, the user can split a single image into two completely different pictures. The website just requires a login and one of his photos as authentication, rather than passwords. When a user signs in and uploads a new picture, the server may utilise Oct (Optical Character Recognition) to capture identifying information. Therefore, it may be able to identify the user by matching the ID it generates with the one it already has. Our idea allows for authentication without giving up sensitive data like ID numbers, requires less computing power, and precludes simulated efforts to break hashes.

articleTitle: A Usable Enhanced Dynamic BFT Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Block chain technology, which evolved as a distributed system preserving a public ledger through consensus protocol, is showing great promise in many different contexts, including the supply chain, the financial sector, the internet of things (IoT), and so on. Important in the development of the block chain infrastructure is the use of consensus mechanisms, and one such mechanism is Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) protocols. However, the vast majority of BFT protocols are inherently unable to be used in realistic settings due to their lack of dynamic features (i.e., nodes can't join or leave a functioning system) and the inability to penalize unsuccessful nodes. In this paper, we provide the Dynamic Enhanced BFT (DEBFT) protocol for handling dynamic properties and faulty node penalties. DEBFT, which is based on Honey Badger BFT, uses Dynamic Threshold Identity-based Encryption and Distributed Key Generation to facilitate consensus group changes without requiring a complete system reconfiguration. Additionally, assessment metrics are provided to evaluate consensus nodes and remove problematic nodes.

abstract: An abundance of articles documenting the efficacy of deep learning in the area of medical picture segmentation attest to its widespread adoption and application for this purpose. As a first step, we classify the most popular literatures according to a multi-level structure that ranges from coarse to fine, in contrast to traditional questionnaires that straightforwardly divide literatures of deep learning on medical image segmentation into several groups and incorporate articles in depth for each group. Second, although unsupervised learning methods were introduced in many older surveys, they are not widely used now, therefore this work only covers supervised and poorly supervised methods. We provide a literature review of supervised learning strategies, focusing on three key areas: network block design, backbone network selection, and loss function optimization. We explore the literature on weakly supervised learning strategies in terms of data enhancement, transfer learning, and interactive categorization, each of which stands on its own. This study organizes the literatures in a totally different way from previous ones, making it easier for readers to comprehend the key logic and leading them to consider acceptable advances in medical picture segmentation utilizing deep learning methodologies.

We still have a minimal awareness of how the value of big data has indeed been and will be realized. What research has been done in the last ten years in the social scientists to address big data concerns and to increase our understanding of big data analytics is still not apparent. articleTitle: Improved Detection of Cyber-Attacks Using a Bi-Directional RNN with LSTM Deep Learning Model

abstract: The threat of cyber-attacks is a major concern in today's world, and accurate and efficient detection of these attacks is crucial for ensuring the security of critical systems. Traditional approaches to cyber attack detection have limitations, and therefore, novel methods are necessary to overcome these challenges. However, predicting cyber attacks presents unique difficulties due to the long-range dependency and nonlinearity of attack data. In this study, we propose a deep learning model, called BRNN-LSTM, that uses bi-directional RNNs with LSTM to overcome these challenges and improve the accuracy of cyber attack detection. Our investigation shows that BRNN-LSTM achieves significantly higher prediction accuracy in detecting cyber-attack rates compared to statistical techniques commonly used in the field. The proposed model uses a bi-directional architecture that enables it to capture the dependencies in the input data from both past and future time steps. LSTM cells are employed to capture the long-term dependencies and nonlinearity of attack data. The results show that BRNN-LSTM is an effective model for detecting cyber attacks. The proposed model outperforms traditional statistical methods, and it can capture the complex dependencies in the data that are crucial for the accurate detection of cyber attacks. Therefore, we believe that BRNN-LSTM can be a valuable addition to the existing methods for cyber attack detection and can significantly improve the security of critical systems.

Researchers in the fields of information technology and cyber security might perhaps benefit from the offered thorough review study.

articleTitle: Review on Different Memristor Emulator Models and Its Current Trend
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: This study has explored the fundamental theory of ongoing development such as memristors, as well as their models and I-V characteristics. They have a wide range of possible applications in several technical areas. The latest application in engineering is introduced neuromorphic. Non- volatility, high scalability, leakage current close to minimum, and compatibility with CMOS technology are just a few of the benefits of memristive devices. The literature review covers major discoveries and research milestones in this field since the invention began.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Blockchain Technology has acquired notoriety in both scholar and industry due to its decentralized, versatile, security and irrefutable characteristics. The blockchain is a disseminated data set that holds record of exchanges that are conveyed among members in its most essential structure. Manufactured exchanges can't pass aggregate certification since every exchange requires the understanding of various individuals. A record can never be changed or erased after it has been made and recognized by the blockchain. After the Internet, blockchain innovation is presently viewed as the main development. The previous could tackle the trust issue utilizing shared systems administration and public-key cryptography assuming the last option interfaces individuals to all the more likely comprehend online business processes. The objective of this paper is to take a gander at the critical instances of blockchain innovation's comprehensive effect and see it as an inseparable part of our daily existences.

articleTitle: Management of business using machine learning for decision making
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: While machine learning and artificial intelligence might lessen expenses and increment the viability of business processes, these methods can likewise obliterate the worth of an organization, some of the time with serious repercussions. The failure to perceive and control that chance might make a few directors put off carrying out innovations, keeping them from arriving at their maximum capacity. Machine learning has colossal potential for decreasing the expense of labor and products, speeding up organization activities, and further developing client care. In the ongoing time of uncommon specialized headway, it is recognized as one of the huge application regions, and reception is advancing across essentially all businesses. In light of this, Researchers first provide a brief review of the different types of machine learning before presenting three different ways that machine learning is used in businesses. The trade-off between machine-learning algorithms' accuracy and interpretability is then covered. This is an important factor to take into account while choosing the best approach for the task at hand.

articleTitle: Empirical Method to Analysis Mobile Payment Authentication Enhancement using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: One of the fundamental IoT technologies, near-fleld communication (NFC), has made mobile payments possible for a variety of applications. As the design of payment systems has been transformed by crypto currencies like Bitcoin, the technology has grown in popularity. However, this system is vulnerable to security issues including man-in-the-middle attacks, double-spending, and replay attacks, necessitating the use of other technologies like blockchain. The necessity to implement blockchain-based crypto currency payment is driven by worries about the security and privacy of transactions made utilising NFC technology. For example, NFC payment has come under fire for the lack of safeguards against potential assaults like brute force or double-spending. As a result, adopting blockchain technology is anticipated to enhance both user experience and the security characteristics of the NFC mobile payment system. Because it allows for direct transactions without using a third party, blockchain technology has been commended for facilitating equitable payment. In order to facilitate value transfer utilising IoT devices, blockchain cryptocurrency integration will transform the NFC payment method. In order to solve security and privacy issues, it is important to combine NFC with blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies. The goal of this research is to examine the possibility for integrating cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and blockchain technology into the NFC payment mechanism.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Diagnosis and Recommendation System for Chronic Diseases Using Patient Health Records
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The proliferation of IoT applications, notably in the sphere of health care, has led to discussion of patient health records utilising data gathered from IoT-connected devices. Biological data from patients' medical records is mined for health analysis and diagnosis. Certain types of illness, known as chronic illnesses, are completely quiet yet devastating if left untreated. Recent years have seen an uptick in interest from academics in the utilization of patient health information data for the pre-emptive identification of chronic diseases. On the other side, healthcare and medical assistance have benefited enormously from the implementation of recommender systems that use machine learning techniques. Using an Internet of Things device, this research implemented a medical recommendation system to aid in the early diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. The current technique made use of the dataset of digitised patient health records that is housed in the Physio Net data repository. The current dataset contains patient health records that have been documented in accordance with the diseases that have been identified and the doctor's diagnosis. The recommended technique uses K-nearest neighbour classification to identify the kind of ailment before using collaborative filtering to select the optimal course of treatment for patients. The outcomes of using the suggested methodology show that this technique, which is based on using patient symptom similarity, produces better results than previous methods and has a high precision in diagnosing and forecasting chronic illnesses. After determining the kind of disease using the closest neighbour classification method, the collaborative filtering strategy is utilised to select the optimal course of therapy for patients. The outcomes of using the suggested methodology show that this technique, which is based on using patient symptom similarity, produces better results than previous methods and achieves better accuracy in diagnosing and forecasting chronic illnesses.

articleTitle: A Critical Analysis of Applying Computer Vision In Building an Intelligent System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The terminology "computer vision" refers to the method that leverages technologies of intelligent systems such as artificial intelligence (AI) to enable computers to gather useful information from visual sources. The automated activities are demonstrated previously using computer vision understanding. The definition, examples, as well as uses of computer vision, are covered in this article. For computer vision to be totally successful there must be a huge collection. When they lack the knowledge required to execute the task at hand, these systems periodically discover trends, which cause this to occur. Hence, the research has evaluated the notion of computer vision in diverse fields of operations through the literature review as well as in the analysis and discussion portion of the study. Since the literature review and data analysis of the research is done through secondary sources, an imperative notion of review has been gathered and presented. Therefore, the significance of computer vision in assembling intelligent systems like AI and other new technologies has given discussed in the research.

articleTitle: Framework Towards Detection of Stress Level Through Classifying Physiological Signals Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: It becomes increasingly stressful to be a human, and not everyone is capable of managing their own lives well. Working IT professionals in the industry nowadays frequently have stress-related disorders. Even while pressure is a common illness that affects daily life, including family, friends, and studying, the great majority are unaware of it. The risk of pressure among the representatives is increasing as a result of changing work and lifestyle societies. Despite the fact that many businesses and organisations offer strategies related to emotional well-being and make an effort to improve the working environment climate, the problem is still beyond of our control. Stress also affects wellness, both physically and mentally, at all ages.When people repeatedly feel the negative impacts of pressure, stress can lead to a variety of emotional and mental conditions, including anxiety and depression. As a consequence, the method for controlling and lowering tension with in operation is selected.Complex sign interpretation is used in agree for force detection, accounting of factors including body temp, interstitial fluid, student achievement, and Electrochemical cell skin reaction. The alternate strategy for dealing with this problem also makes use of a few biological markers and visual elements (eye conclusions, head growth) to track an individual's arterial pressure when they're operating.However, these assessments are intrusive and less acceptable in actual use. Each sensor's data is compared to a pressure record, a cutting-edge metric used to identify anxiety.In response to feelings of fear, the framework arranges video conferences with experts.

articleTitle: Improvement of Power Grid Transient Stability Using Plug-In Hybrid Electric Vehicles: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: A Plug-In Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) acts as an energy supplier and power source in discharging mode operating as Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology and act as a loading charging mode when operating as Grid-to-Vehicle (G2V) technology ultimately called as vehicle-grid integration. These are fast evolving concepts and major focus areas in research. Most of the time, RES (Renewable Energy System) fail to generate the needed amount of potential or power and also injects leading reactive power into the grid as it behaves as decoupled and inertia-less or less stable system which create stability issues. Hence, most convenient way to maintain the stability is Peak Load Shaving or Load Shedding. Here comes the need of PHEVs as they can provide that needed power to the grid through V2G technology in peak load hours. In this paper, some published works with the objective to improve the stability of the grid using PHEV has been reviewed.

articleTitle: Improvement of Solid Waste Management by Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: "Solid waste management (SWM)" is a critical institutional arrangement responsible for handling urban waste in order to provide an environmentally favourable environment for city dwellers. In general, numerous technologies are being used and explored by experts in order to improve the operation of SWM and reduce waste creation. However, trash disposal management remains a challenge. As a result, there is a need for technologies that may involve humans in order to achieve the goal of minimising waste. At the moment, blockchain technology is an appropriate solution for SWM since it allows for time tracing operations, protect data transactions, and an automatic incentive system. The worldwide waste and resource issues need as well as provide significant push for improved and better environmentally friendly waste management. The repurposing, repurposing, or reclamation of resources and waste streams that were previously disposed of in landfills or incinerators is progressing. Despite the fact that numerous legislation and regulations have since been passed in response to this, a number of ongoing issues still plague programmes designed to facilitate the necessary, widespread conversions to solid waste management. This opinion piece investigates the suitability of block chain technology in solving these difficulties. This opinion piece investigates the potential of blockchain technology in solving these difficulties. Describe the advantages and obstacles for block chain in (1) providing consistency in business and waste property rights, (2) complementing legal and policy proposals by rewarding sustainable waste management, and (3) ensuring confidentiality and anonymity for both organizations and individuals.

articleTitle: The Impact of Machine Learning (ML) Optimization of supply chain management domain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The paper explores the impact of machine learning on supply chain optimization and its potential to improve profitability. The study highlights the benefits of utilizing machine learning algorithms in areas such as demand forecasting, inventory management, and logistics optimization. The results show that incorporating machine learning techniques can lead to significant improvements in accuracy, speed, and efficiency in these areas, thereby leading to an increase in profitability. The research also points out the limitations of traditional approaches and the need for continuous improvement and adaptation of machine learning models. The paper concludes by emphasizing the potential of machine learning in driving transformative change in the supply chain and its critical role in enabling organizations to stay ahead in a rapidly changing business environment.

articleTitle: A 5G NB-IoT Infrastructure for Secured Demand-Side Information Transmission and Predictive Analyses in Smarter Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: In sequence to start making utilization of Dedicated Short - spectrum of devices (NB-IoT) just on buyer edge of the energy grid, improve the security of transferring details, and utilize market records, we focus on the dependable interaction, trustworthy assistance, and interesting analyzation of "5G + Smart Grid" as well as we construct a conclusive remedy that includes encrypting data stations, managed service providers, and clever analytical strategies. The proposed 5GNBIoT design from the research can aid in grid control and market responses in contrast to increasing the degree of connectivity among Five G and the nationwide grid. This study will therefore help bring a new wave of electronic innovations to the modern grid, develop a deeper integrated services or software for the "5G + Modern Wire," improve the networks' cognitive, and advance the "dual carbon" goal of the energy network.

articleTitle: The Role of Machine Learning Algorithms in Developing Android App and to do Malware Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Because there are so many issues that have had suitable solutions, cybersecurity is now the subject that worries computer scientists and system administrators the most. The rapid development of information technology and its inherent integration into every aspect of our lives have made it possible to analyze and identify a broad variety of harmful software packages and the targets of these programmes. Malware exists.Recently, Android malware has gotten some notice. It seems to attract a lot of attention on the internet. Android is one of the most well-liked operating systems that dominates the operating system market. In 2020, 85% of smartphones will run on the Android operating system, according to statistics from the system. Mobile virus attacks have increased in frequency over time. Known to infect a phone system with applications that seem harmless but really contain malware is one of the most popular approaches. Malware on cellphones has already been detected using machine learning. Deep learning and supervised learning techniques have been used to achieve this. Drawing on consumer rights, this study evaluates the effectiveness of multiple categorization approaches to find virus in Android apps.

articleTitle: An Empirical Assessment of Wireless Communication Technology Issues in the Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Smart home technology, an Internet of Things (IoT) application, offers families convenience, comfort, and control. The purpose of this study is to construct a full model that can account for a large amount of the diversity in customers' intentions to embrace smart home technologies. To do this, this study creates an integrated model and evaluates it using structural equation modelling (SEM) utilising data acquired from 156 respondents, based on the technological acceptance model, diffusion of innovation theory, and consumer perceptions of innovativeness. The findings suggest that major criteria impacting the adoption of smart home technologies include compatibility, perceived usefulness, and perceived simplicity of operation. This study adds to the corpus of information on the Internet of Things, specifically in the field of research on smart houses. There have been some debates over the theoretical and practical repercussions.

articleTitle: A Review of Multi-Access Edge Devices Utilizing Software System Design for System Sectioning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Mobile cellular systems of the 5th generation (5G), which support highly-reliable & low-discontinuation systeming, actual time & adaptive data computation, heavy processing, as well as widespread device connection, offer a promising foundation for new, creative, & varied Iot systems. End-to-End (E2E) system slicing options offer a viable method for allocating & distributing resources that enables carriers to adaptably deliver configurable virtualization & devoted logic systeming over shared infrastructural facilities. A Multi-Access Edge Computation (MEC) technology must be integrated into 5G systems in order to support many of systeming slicing's application scenarios, including autonomous vehicles as well as Google Stadia. Edge computing is expected to be one of the driving forces behind 5G & 6G mobile cellular systems; however its function in system slicing is yet to explore.We look at MEC &system slicing based on application instances that are specific to the delivery of 5G services. With MEC application cases offering system scalability, adaptability, versatility, & automation, enhancements to the cloud-native 5G base have recently come into focus. A cloud-native micro-services framework is envisaged, along with some of its possible use applications for 5G system slicing. In addition, this paper goes into detail on current standardization initiatives, supporting advancements, & applications for E2E system slicing. This report concludes by outlining unresolved study problems & issues while offering potential fixes & suggestions.

articleTitle: Multistage N/W Intrusion - Detection system implementation through DL and Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The current worldwide surge in hack and computer cluster attacks has heightened the demand for stronger prevention and detection systems. The system that detects intrusions (IDS) is crucial for identifying net assaults and abnormalities, which are becoming bigger and more widespread. We provide a novel three different dnnvision-based technique for detecting security breaches in this paper. The circuits are used to create pictures of four segments (Red, Colored, Aquamarine, and Alpha). However, the categorization that was done on the photographs is used to train and verify the well-known computer vision framework ResNet50. Two freely available standardized datasets, UNSW-NB15 and Regularly then used manage Denial of service ( dos, are utilised to evaluate the proposed technique. On the Ub test, the proposed approach successfully identifies the generalized exploit 99.8% of the time. The suggested approach achieves 99.7% precision on both the diagnostics of vehicles coming upon that Two or more homogeneous Intrusion data or the detection of the Gadget.

articleTitle: Computational Intelligence Router of Machine and Artificial Intelligence Learning for the Expansion of Agriculture's Manufacturing Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The economic sector includes agriculture as a major player. Around the world, the primary issue and hot topic is agriculture automation. As a result of the population boom, there is a huge increase in the need for both jobs and food. Farmers employed traditional techniques, which included insufficient to meet these needs. This led to the introduction of new automated techniques. These innovative techniques supplied the world’s food needs while giving billions of people access to jobs. An agricultural revolution has been sparked by artificial intelligence. With the use of this technology, crop yields are now more resistant to many conditions like population increase, climate change, job troubles, and food security concerns. The primary goal of this study is to evaluate the numerous ways artificial intelligence is being used in agriculture, including the use of sensors and other tools built into drones and robots for weeding, spraying, and irrigation. The excessive use of pesticides, herbicides, water, and other resources is reduced by these technologies, and the soil fertility is maintained. They also aid in the effective use of labor, which raises productivity and quality. In order to provide a concise summary of the current state of agricultural automation, including the use of drones and robots for weeding, this study analyses the research of several researchers. Along with two automated weeding strategies, the various ways of soil water sensing are described. This study discusses the use of drones as well as the numerous spraying and crop monitoring techniques that may be utilized with them.

articleTitle: Utilizing Internet of Things in Intelligent City, and Medical Sharing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Due to the unsatisfactory national public hospital management system, excessive medical costs, a lack of channels, and some other issues affecting people’s ability to support themselves. The focus of public concern is on medical issues, namely those represented by "an inadequate medical system, subpar medical services, healthcare challenges, and exorbitant expenses." The main objective of this article is to develop a set of smart health data network platform technologies that will enable patients to receive elevated treatment and diagnosis options with low waiting times and expenses.. To properly accomplish "everyone’s heath, everyone’s health," that issue of "difficult and costly medical treatment" must be resolved. This project develops and designs a system for distributed health information sharing and integration. Then, a few premier local hospitals adopt it. These results of the poll and interviews research show that the healthcare field has substantially improved and that smart medicine distribution has increased by roughly 79 percent among general population compared to earlier medical treatments.

Author Keywords: Intelligent medical sharing in cities Network of things

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Variables for Deepfake Video Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Deepfake detection at the video level has not been as widely studied as at the image level, as it involves analyzing sequences of frames in a temporal context to detect manipulation, which is more complex than analyzing individual images. In this research, we seek to demonstrate how the current image and sequence classifiers-based approaches for deepfake detection struggle to generalize to new manipulation techniques. In order to improve the generalisation ability to identify new types of deepfake images or videos, we suggest spatio-temporal variables that are described by 3D CNNs. We demonstrate that spatial features acquire unique deep fake method-specific qualities, but spatio-temporal features capture common deep fake method-specific attributes. Using the FaceForensics++ dataset, we present a detailed examination of how the sequential and 3D CNN video encoders are making use of temporal information. We discover that, in contrast to previous sequence encoders, our method incorporates local spatio-temporal relationships as well as irregularities in the deepfake videos. We demonstrate that our technique surpasses conventional approaches in terms of generalisation abilities via substantial investigations on the FF++.

articleTitle: Ecosystem Implementations in Smart City through Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Smart cities are structured on smart devices to govern urban management. It encapsulates smart governance, smart mobility, smart infrastructure, smart homes, smart streets and many more. However, the essence of such smartness lies in the internet of things (IoT) sensors calibrated through blockchain technology to ensure the security, auditability and traceability of activities within and around the cities. By doing so, governance matters and urban management can be handled efficiently. However, as a novel field, few studies have focused on this arena. This research aims to assess the role of Blockchain in smart city ecosystems through previous literature and to develop novel inferences by validating the theoretical framework through quantitative analysis. It would assist policymakers and governments to optimize the digital infrastructure fully. The considered arena of assessment included Tokenization and attention was also given to decentralized governance (De-governance) in blockchain towards smart city ecosystem. The research inferences would facilitate the literature advancement in the domain of smart cities and blockchain integration. The research would also be resounding towards the role of blockchain technologies in smart governance.

articleTitle: Sun Tracking Solar Energy System - An Alternate and Emerging Energy Unit in 21st Century
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Solar photovoltaics (PV) and sunlight trigger thermochemical reactions. The photovoltaic effect allows solar cells to convert sunlight into useful energy. Although solar energy is sustainable and eco-friendly, it is also quite inefficient. Solar energy is the future of clean energy and a powerful weapon in the battle against climate change caused by humans. It is possible to harness the sun's rays to heat meals and power devices. The goal of this project is to make a tracking system that can find the direction of sun on its own to trap more of solar energy. The placement of the solar panel and its ability to track the sun's course must be carefully considered. The solar panel's tracking system will keep it always perpendicular to the sun, which is the best way to convert sunlight into energy. Photo resistors will be used as the detectors in this design. A solar panel, gear motors, a microcontroller, and a light sensor will all be part of the system. When compared to solar panels without monitoring equipment, our solution could increase energy output by up to 40 percent. Due to the greater cost of the components, solar panels with higher efficiency gets impacted with cost and utility perception.

articleTitle: Text Analytics in Modern Healthcare using NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The healthcare industry is facing a major shift in how patient care is administered. Data-driven decisions are becoming increasingly important to reduce costs and improve patient outcomes. Text analytics is one of the tools being used to help make sense of unstructured data, such as medical notes and records. This paper provides an overview of sources of health data, current work that employs text analytics and the challenges of text analytics. Text analytics has the potential to revolutionize the way healthcare is administered. It can provide a better understanding of patient health, yield more accurate diagnoses and treatments, and ultimately, improve patient results. The use of text analytics can also improve the accuracy of patient records for data-driven decisions and reduce costs. However, there are many challenges associated with the implementation of text analytics in healthcare. These include issues related to data privacy, accuracy, and data collection. The implications of using text analytics in modern healthcare are far-reaching. With the right implementation and data-driven decisions, the healthcare industry can improve the treatment experience and reduce costs. Text analytics has the potential to provide meaningful insights into patient health, yield more accurate diagnoses and treatments, and ultimately revolutionize the way healthcare is delivered.

articleTitle: AI-Assisted Resource Allocation for Improved Business Efficiency and Profitability
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: The emergence of smart devices has raised demand for numerous computational paradigms, including cloud computing, fog computing, and the Internet of Things. But even in these paradigms, efficient resource allocation is still difficult. This article provides a thorough assessment of the literature on the use of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques in computational paradigms for resource allocation optimization. As far as we are aware, there are no studies of resource allocation methods based on AI in various computing paradigms. The analyzed machine learning-based methods are divided into two categories: multi - layer perception and evolutionary computation. DL-based techniques are also surveyed, as well as how they work in conjunction with RL. An examination of unexplored study areas and a conclusion round out the review.

articleTitle: AI-Based advanced Talk-chatbot for Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Traditional technologies are transforming how businesses interact with their customers, creating demands for prompt responses & continuous accessibility. Students frequently have questions about college & university policies & procedures, academic process, extracurricular, as well as other aspects of educational career. There is a lack of service satisfaction because the educational advisers as well as the student affairs staff are overloaded with inquiries & unable to respond to them right away. In our work, we develop a multilingual talkbot that converses among learners in both English & Arabic using Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies. The dialog bot was created in Python & is intended for use by students to answer questions about advice. We are utilizing a intent built domain-specific compilation as the knowledge source for the talkbots, which is made up of the typical queries students ask advisers & their answers. By analysing the inputs, the talktbot engine ascertains the client's needs and, with an efficiency of 80.00 % in English and 75.00 % in Arabic, finds the most reasonable answer that meets the intention. We also tested the software solution as well as the talkbot's precision using field tests with pupils to see how well it responded to live input.

articleTitle: Academic Performance Prediction of At-Risk Students using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Imparting quality education is a top priority of higher education institutions. Leaving at risk students unattended would adversely impact the quality of education. Predicting the academic performance of students is one of the basis for improving the quality of education, as it would help the institution to take early and timely measures to support the low-performing students and improve their performance. At the same time, it has identified that the prediction of student performance considered as challenging one due to large dataset in educational environment. However, Educational Data Mining (EDM) using machine learning techniques is an emerging research area, which allows the researchers to effectively process and evaluate the educational data collected from different sources. In this paper, we propose the use of support vector machine (SVM) on an imbalanced dataset to predict the academic performance of students.

articleTitle: Securing International Law Against Cyber Attacks through Blockchain Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Cyber-attacks have become a growing concern for governments, organizations, and individuals worldwide. In this paper, we explore the use of blockchain technology to secure international law against cyber-attacks. We discuss the advantages of blockchain technology in providing secure and transparent data storage and transmission, and how it can enhance the security of international law. We also review the current state of international law regarding cyber-attacks and the need for a robust and effective legal framework to address cyber threats. The study proposes a blockchain-based approach to secure international law against cyber-attacks. We examine the potential of blockchain technology in providing a decentralized and tamper-proof database that can record and track the implementation of international laws related to cyber-attacks. We also discuss how smart contracts can be utilized to automate compliance with international laws and regulations related to cybersecurity. The study also discusses the challenges and limitations of using blockchain technology to secure international law against cyber-attacks. These include the need for interoperability between different blockchain networks, the high energy consumption of blockchain technology, and the need for international cooperation in implementing and enforcing international laws related to cybersecurity. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of the potential of blockchain technology in securing international law against cyber-attacks. It highlights the need for a robust legal framework to address cyber threats and emphasizes the importance of international cooperation in implementing and enforcing international laws related to cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Business Decision-Making: An Analysis of AI-Based Services
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being used to make important decisions due to the exponential growth of data in both society and business. However, current literature does not adequately address how to categorize and organize AI-based services according to decision-making patterns. To fill this gap, we present and assess seven styles for AI-based decision-making processes, focusing on the company context and building on the concept of justification in knowledge. Using correlations, we analyze real-world examples of businesses providing AI-based services. Our research provides a foundation for future studies and aids experts in developing AI-based services, while also contributing to situation theory and descriptive understanding of AI. Customers' reliance on AI-based services for personal and important decisions makes our research particularly relevant.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology for Protecting Ingenuity of Image
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Hash link is exploited for digital images to obtain imagecord concepts derived from cryptographic formation. The primary difference from the Blockchain imagecord concept is that the data block will not be kept as a collection of individual blocks but rather will be joined by an embedding method. Accordingly, standard image files are used in the same way as it was created before. An extra data block is also cultivated in it to preserve the imagecord from its origin point. The proposed method requires no supplementary data apart from the original image. This solution is also suitable for multiple graphics file formats, making it a portable version with platform independence. Simultaneously, this method also gives higher security against the forgery of the original file without losing its properties. This was attained by embedding the hashing data with the image’s data block without losing its integrity by preventing alternation. This paper deals with the concept of Blockchain distributed ledger to apply in imagecord by embedding algorithms and data blocks in the image.

articleTitle: An IoT-based real-time sensing model for rainfall-runoff using big data analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Advance Computing and Innovative Technologies in Engineering (ICACITE)
abstract: Millions of dollars’ worth of infrastructure has been destroyed as a result of floods' destructive effects in the past. It is a serious issue that leads to crop degradation, population decline, loss of infrastructures, and the deconstruction of many public utilities. An efficient strategy to handle this is to warn the neighborhood of an impending flood and give them plenty of time to leave and safeguard their property. There is still no global, universal system that can gather, store, evaluate huge information and produce flood prediction results despite extensive research. Using the convergence of big data and the Exponential Smoothing Technique (EST), forecasting architecture and a social collaborative IOT-based smart flood monitoring are suggested in this research. Based on flood events tracked by rainfall sensors in the catchment, we implemented an EST-based IoT network model to simulate the rainfall-runoff process. The findings demonstrate that, as opposed to physical-based and conceptual models, the suggested network is more appropriate for rainfall-runoff models. Data is retrieved from the open-source Kaggle meteorological database, and experimental evaluation is done. The results demonstrated the viability of the 23 suggested architectural designs.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence & AGILE Based Business Development Review

Images are often used in the medical industry for the purposes of diagnosis as well as surgery. In this article, a study on the use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for clinical picture segmentation is presented, coupled with an approach for evolutionary model compression. On a collection of clinical pictures, four distinct models—UNet, ENet, ECO-UNet, and ECO-ENet—were assessed. The accuracy of their segmentation was gauged using the Dice coefficient, sensitivity, and specificity. The findings indicate that although the UNet and ENet models had high segmentation accuracy, the ECO-UNet and ECO-ENet models had even greater accuracy. The model size was subsequently decreased using the evolutionary compression technique, and even at high compression ratios, the compressed models' performance was comparable to that of the original models. These findings show how successful the evolutionary compression approach is in reducing model size as well as the potential of CNNs for clinical picture segmentation tasks. In environments with limited resources, this strategy may be very helpful. Overall, the research demonstrates that evolutionary compression and CNNs provide a potential method for clinical picture segmentation..
